Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a Data Analyst, you enjoy diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges.

As a client-facing data analyst on our team, you’ll work with and guide a multi-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast-paced, Agile environment. You’ll use your knowledge in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients. You will also work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to impact missions.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


Experience with data visualization techniques and tools, including Power BI, Tableau or Microsoft Fabric, and Spark or PySpark for data analysis
Experience with structured data using tools, including SQL, R, or Python programming languages, data visualization software, and statistical analysis
Experience analyzing data sets to spot trends and patterns that can be translated into actionable insights
Experience with statistics and statistical software, including Excel
Experience in data validation and cleaning to ensure the quality and integrity of data
Knowledge of automation and how to tighten work processes into a true flow
Knowledge of how to apply statistical analysis techniques to large datasets
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience developing Microsoft 365 power applications
Experience with development in Maven Smart System (MSS)
Experience with agile methodologies
Experience with working on real-time data and streaming applications
Knowledge of machine learning techniques and tools
Ability to develop scripts and programs for converting various types of IoT and sensor data into usable formats
Ability to communicate technical information and recommendations to peers, engineers, and analytic customers
Master's degree
Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) Certification



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Title: AUTOMATION & DATA ANALYST
Description:
We value: Safety, Integrity, Ownership, Collaboration, Service, Sustainability

Moses Lake Industries, Inc. (MLI) is a rapidly growing producer of ultra-pure chemical products, serving the semiconductor, silicon and flat-panel screen industries worldwide. We deliver world class products to the leaders of the industries we serve. Handling and working around hazardous materials and chemical manufacturing equipment is routine.

You will be working for a midsized company with great people and a history of steady growth and profitability. Sound like a match? If you are prepared to work in an exciting and rewarding environment, we look forward to considering your experience and qualifications.

Shift/Hours/Location: M-F, 8am-5pm, Onsite, Moses Lake, WA

What You Will Be Working On


Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, manual, or inefficient processes.
Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using tools such as Power Automate, Python, RPA platforms, or similar technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline workflows and increase operational efficiency.
Monitor and maintain automated processes, ensuring reliability and scalability.
Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
Develop dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Translate complex data into clear insights, trends, and actionable recommendations.
Perform root cause analysis to support continuous improvement initiatives.
Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations between systems.
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across platforms.
Support data governance and compliance practices.
Work closely with business units (e.g., operations, finance, QA, supply chain) to understand requirements.
Communicate findings and automation solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Provide training and documentation for implemented tools and processes.
Uphold all MLI policies and “MLI Code of Conduct.”
Strict compliance with Environmental and Safety regulations.
Compliance and individual accountability with the MLI Quality System and ISO Registration is required. It is the employee’s commitment to ensure that the Company’s actual practices and procedures are exercised as directed.
Perform other duties as assigned to support and sustain a high performing team.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in science base program or business administration (high preference for a degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, or Engineering). Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and continuous improvement.
Effective time manager with high organization & managing competing priorities; ability to prioritize and plan operational workload, balance competing priorities.
Strong attention to detail, observation, organization, analytical, problem-solving & leadership skills.
Strong technical and IT skills, toolset usage, planning and problem solving, including applicable technology, tools & industry best practices.
Excellent communication, listening & presentation (written & verbal) skills in English.
Work effectively with high tolerance of ambiguity and ability to follow instructions.
Assertive, self-starter that sets initiative and goals.
Critical thinking, scenario planning, & risk mitigation techniques and systems.
Ability to travel (All US States & International), up to 75% of time.
Office location at Moses Lake, WA, Milwaukie, OR, remote upon approval. Demonstrated ability to work remotely effectively with no impact to results.


Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
Minimum of three (3) years managing complex technical teams.
Minimum of two (2) years of experience in data analysis, automation, or related roles.
Strong proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Python, or R).
Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
Familiarity with automation platforms (Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, etc.).
Knowledge of databases, ETL processes, and data modeling.
Basic understanding of APIs and system integrations.
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Knowledge of Lean/Six Sigma or process improvement methodologies.
Experience in scripting or programming for automation (Python, VBA).
Familiarity with ERP/MES systems in manufacturing environments.


Salary & Benefits

Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range: $70K-$120K

We offer the following benefits: compensation, medical, vision, and dental insurance benefits.


You can work in an environment where teamwork is encouraged and where you have the opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Generous PTO: Your time off is important!
Medical/Dental/Vision: Majority of premiums paid by MLI. Includes virtual medical and mental health options.
Additional Health Coverage: FSA and HSA available. Voluntary insurance options include life and AD&D, accident, hospitalization, and critical illness.
Earn More: We offer a generous discretionary bonus program in addition to salary/wage.
401 (K) Savings Plan: Jump start your retirement with MLI’s employer matching contributions.
Company – Paid Benefits: Long-Term Disability Insurance, EAP, Fitness Club Membership Program, & Education Assistance Program.
Additional Benefits: We provide position-based clothing, travel expenses, training and relocation assistance available.


WORKING CONDITIONS

Duties are generally performed indoors in an office and high purity manufacturing environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. When working in the presence of safety hazards, the employee is expected to follow company safety rules and use proper personal protective equipment such as: hardhat, safety glasses and full leather shoes, etc.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Primary Purpose

The Data Analyst Independently performs data analysis; document, recommend, and make process and

configuration changes to data functions and/or systems; and perform strategic data analysis to support

management. Requires in-depth and broad understanding of the company’s data configuration and

needs to analyze and resolve problems.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Create, run, and disseminate weekly and monthly reports as directed by stakeholders and team.
ERP support, testing and implementation including CPP
Warehouse Management System support & testing for warehouse
Excel support for store, management for stores and Home Office.
Corporate EDI support.
SharePoint support, update, & changes for Merchandising.
D-Com testing and support for data exchange between Compass and Ecommerce platforms.
Data integrity, hierarchy, maintenance.

Applies creative thinking in the development of business processes.
Participates in user testing of new system functionality.
Acquire subject matter expertise in the functions and activities of the various departments, including applicable laws, rules, regulations, procedures, and technical operations.
Provides technical assistance in training, mentoring, and coaching professional and technical staff.
Establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships.
Acts as a team lead on designated projects or assignments and may provide work direction to technical or clerical staff.

Comprehensive knowledge of the products Country Supplier sells.
Perform daily cleaning – such as, but not limited to, vacuuming, replacing full trashes with new trash bags, and sweeping.
Other duties assigned as needed.

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics or similar field is preferred.
Two (2) years of experience in business process analysis, data base management, change management, and/or analytical or research projects preferred.
Experience with ERP systems and/or Epicor Software
Experience with presentation, spreadsheet, flow charting and work processing.
Understanding of methods of developing business and data process specification; procedures and testing of business functions within computer systems.
Effective project documentation skills including business functions, desk manuals, and configuration documentation.
Handle multiple and parallel projects concurrently.
Basis project management techniques, techniques for managing change.
Advanced Excel, MS Access, and application software knowledge
Exceptional time management and organizational skills
Ability to write logical, comprehensive, concise reports and correspondence.
Exceptional interpersonal skills
Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. Title: Product Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
Your Job

Flint Hills Resources is seeking a Product Analyst/Data Analyst to join our team in Wichita, KS. As an IT Product Analyst/Data Analyst, you will serve as a highly capable contributor who helps ensure strong delivery execution and continuity within the product team. You will play a critical role in translating product direction into high-quality delivery outcomes and in extending the team's impact across the broader technology ecosystem. This role is well-suited for someone ready to take accountability for delivery outcomes, influence how work gets done, and contribute meaningfully to business and technology objectives.

What You Will Do


Work closely with the business to understand problems at their root and drive solutions through technology — whether through your own development work or by collaborating across the business, software engineering, data architecture and solutions architecture.
Develop and maintain scripts, agents, and lightweight applications using tools like Python to automate processes, move data, and solve business problems.
Understand data models, system integrations, and application behavior to effectively translate business needs into sound technical approaches.
Analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and surface insights that inform product and business decisions — including understanding how application data and APIs translate into graph and analytical data models.
Own projects end-to-end — from problem statement through delivery and adoption — maintaining accountability for outcomes throughout.
Contribute to roadmap development, collaborating closely with product and business leadership to identify new features, enhancements, and incremental improvements aligned with product direction.
Continuously innovate and push the team forward — challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities to transform how work gets done, and raising the bar for those around you.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Experience in IT, data, software engineering, or a business role with demonstrated technical aptitude
A passion for or experience writing scripts, queries, or code (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, AI agents, or equivalent) to solve problems, automate processes, or move and validate data
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions
Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship



What Will Put You Ahead


Experience with Cypher, graph databases, or data modeling
Experience with data engineering or API integrations — building pipelines, moving data, or connecting systems
Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS (e.g., SQS, CloudWatch, Lambda)
Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or prompt engineering
Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data modeling, or analytics — including building reports, dashboards, or data products that inform business decisions
Experience in procurement, accounts payable, source-to-pay, or operations



At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Flint Hills Resources is an industry-leading refining company making the oil and transportation products that keep the world moving. We make a large supply of fuel for gas stations and airports in addition to transporting crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products through 4,000+ miles of pipeline – delivering energy to farmers, manufacturers and families. Our team champions innovation and excellence to help power modern life.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. Title: Data Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. They are responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for various activities from infrastructure planning to business development.

Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.


WORKING CONDITIONS


Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Formal Education


College diploma in Analytics, Computer Science Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology.


Related Experience


Three to five years' experience in the industry


Other Requirements


Experience with reporting tools and software including SSRS, PowerBI, Informatica.
Experience with SSIS or other data ingestion and transformation tools.
Experience using Safe FME for processing geospatial data.
Experience with report writing, organizing, and presenting data in support of decision making
Demonstrates statistical and empirical analytical skills
Knowledge of relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices is an asset
Knowledge of ETL methodologies, T-SQL and ArcGIS is an asset
Familiar with the transportation and logistics industry
Demonstrates ability to learn new skills and acquire industry knowledge
Good spoken and written communication skills
Strong problem solving and organizational skills
Accuracy and attention to detail, with an analytical eye
Superior judgment and tact in dealing with sensitive issues and confidential information.
Demonstrates ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and to effectively handle changing priorities.
Enthusiastic and self-motivated. Works well individually as well as in a team environment.
Creative and intuitive thinker.
Demonstrates commitment to the Port’s Vision.
Resilient. Embraces change and thrives on change.
Proficient in MS Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint; some exposure to MS Access and Project.
Able to obtain security clearance under Transport Canada's Security Clearance Program.


The base salary range for this role is $77,689 - $97,112. This position is eligible for a performance-based variable incentive targeted at 10% of the base salary.

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging are at the heart of PRPA’s culture and play a vital role in our growth strategy. We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels a sense of belonging and can contribute to their maximum potential. Our differences are the reason great things happen here. If you are an applicant in need of accommodation or special assistance throughout the interview process, please submit a request by email to careers@rupertport.com.

Individuals of Indigenous descent are strongly encouraged to apply.

Title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About The Role

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

About The Role


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


What You'll Do


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


Required Qualifications


3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.


Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.


Cross-Functional Impact: Your pricing work carries weight beyond the Pricing team—recommendations you make will shape decisions across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance.
AI-First Skill Building: AI is a first-class tool here, not a buzzword. You will use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily and actively shape how the team adopts them.
Real Ownership: This role pairs tactical pricing execution with strategic contributions. You will report to an experienced Sr. Pricing Analyst with growth-focused mentorship and high visibility from day one.
Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.


Interview Process


Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Sr. Pricing Analyst focused on your analytical approach, pricing experience, and AI tool proficiency.
Take-Home Assignment - A pre-built test requiring high-level analysis, the use and documentation of AI as a working partner, and advanced communication skills to convey complex business recommendations.
In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Cottonwood Heights office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.


Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
Role

The Data Specialist manages the credit union's data infrastructure, ensures the accuracy and accessibility of core and third-party data, and partners with departments across the organization to turn data into actionable insights that support member service and business decisions. This is an in office position.

Major Duties And Responsibilities


Data Warehouse & Database Management: Manage the data warehouse solution; validate and reconcile data from core banking and third-party systems for accuracy and completeness. Administer SQL Server/database environment — updates, table management, indexing, performance tuning, and backup/recovery processes. Maintain data lineage and documentation so data sources, transformations, and definitions are traceable and auditable. Monitor data quality on an ongoing basis (not just at point of extract) using validation rules, exception reporting, and reconciliation checks
Dashboards & Reporting: Partner with management to design, build, and maintain data dashboards that support operational and strategic decision-making. Develop self-service reporting capabilities so departments can pull standard reports without ad hoc requests, freeing capacity for higher-value analysis
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for data-driven requests and custom extracts from internal departments (Lending, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, etc.). Translate business questions into data requirements and deliver clear, actionable outputs. Provide basic data literacy support/training to help staff interpret and use dashboards and reports effectively
Emerging Responsibilities / Current Trends: Data governance: Support development and enforcement of data governance policies — data ownership, access controls, retention schedules, and standardized definitions across systems. Data security & privacy compliance: Ensure data handling practices align with GLBA, NCUA guidance, and other applicable member privacy/security regulations, including monitoring for unauthorized access and supporting audit/exam data requests. Cloud & integration management: Manage or support cloud-hosted data solutions and API-based integrations with fintech/third-party vendors, ensuring secure and reliable data flow
Carries out supplementary tasks aligned with the role and department objectives


Experience

Knowledge and Skills


Two to Five years of similar or related experience, including time spent in preparatory positions


EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES


Microsoft SQL Certification, Associates Degree, College Degree


Interpersonal Skills


Work with third party data providers, management, and subject matter experts, developing data visualizations. Dialog is of technical nature that may require communicating abstract data relationships


Other Skills


Knowledge of technology programs utilized by the financial industry including but limited to JackHenry Symitar, Fiserv, Origence, Internet/Intranet applications, and Microsoft Office products. Has programming platform experience using Object Oriented Architecture, HTML, XML, SOAP, and REST api. Has database management skills with stored procedures, views, and SQL Server 2016 and above

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for you to join our team as a Data Analyst. This position focuses on data analysis for law enforcement support, requiring a combination of investigative data expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work under high-pressure, mission-critical environments. This role will involve working with diverse data sets, ensuring accuracy and integrity while supporting ongoing criminal and civil investigations.

Our ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with law enforcement agencies. We are looking for more than just a "Data Analyst"—this role requires a technologist with excellent communication skills, customer service, and a passion for data and problem-solving.

Contributions

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis and Trend Recognition: Compile and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends across various data sets, locations, and targets.
Data Accuracy and Assessment: Monitor data for accuracy, integrity, authenticity, and relevancy. Identify intelligence gaps and assess data viability for investigative purposes.
Investigative Support: Collaborate with teams to examine data gathered from criminal and civil investigations, developing methodologies to exploit investigative information.
Quality Control & Reporting: Participate in the development of work products, conducting periodic progress reviews and ensuring quality control of findings. Regularly report findings to lead personnel.
Data Entry: Perform data entry from both hard and soft copies into large-scale data processing systems, utilizing tools like optical character readers, scanners, and digital cameras as appropriate.
Law Enforcement Support: Provide critical law enforcement support, interacting with various agencies through multiple channels of communication, while managing data under tight timelines in a high-pressure environment.
Data Visualization and Tools: Leverage MS Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to design and build formulas, charts, pivot tables, and manipulate unstructured data from different platforms.
You will be part of our Data Exploitation Practice!


Qualifications

Required:


Ability to hold a position of SECRET clearance level with the US government.
4 years of Military or law enforcement background or exposure.
Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of work experience OR 9 years of work experience and no degree.
3+ years of experience in SQL and Python
5+ years of experience using data analytic/visualization tools such as MS Excel, Power BI, or others to design charts, create formulas, and analyze unstructured data (can be job or education-based).
2+ years of experience manipulating unstructured data from different platforms; and experience in IT, statistics, computer information systems, auditing, investigative, mathematics, and units of measure
Skilled at multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear communications with stakeholders.
Must be local to El, Paso TX or willing to drive on site 5 days a week.
Applicants selected will be subject to a Government background investigation and must meet eligibility and suitability requirements.


Preferred


Law enforcement/drug data desired.
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-paced environment, including collaboration with various teams.
Strong analytical skills for identifying trends, gaps, and ensuring data accuracy and
Experience with documenting processes and developing SOPs for data handling and
Demonstrated experience in reverse engineering and validation of data processes.
Ability to communicate findings and updates effectively during briefings and team

Description:
Department: University Advancement

Classification: Research Analyst 2

Appointment Type and Duration: Regular, Ongoing

Salary: $22.84 - $34.70 per hour

FTE: 1.0

Hybrid eligible - located in Eugene or Portland, Oregon

Review of Applications Begins

August 31, 2026; position open until filled

Special Instructions to Applicants

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a complete application that includes (1) an online application, (2) a cover letter, and (3) a resume that addresses how they meet the minimum and/or preferred qualifications. Please include the position location (Eugene or Portland) you are applying for.

We are interested in finding the best candidate for the position. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t think you meet every one of our preferred qualifications- use your application to let us know what is meaningful to you about the role and what transferable skills or other qualities you would bring.

If you have questions about the application process or the position, please reach out to fass@uoregon.edu .

Department Summary

University Advancement (UA) supports the University of Oregon’s (UO) mission of providing exceptional teaching, discovery, and service by strategically positioning the university to create awareness, build long-term relationships, and secure resources that increase understanding and further its aims. The division consists of approximately 200 employees primarily working out of Eugene, with offices in Portland and Bend. We are committed to fostering equity and inclusion in a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment that recognizes the value of all members of our community.

The Advancement Strategies and Technology Innovation (ASTI) department is focused on finding the solutions for foundational issues that will best position UO Advancement to achieve its goals around engagement and fundraising. The department has a unique function in that it is based in UO Advancement, but also has strong working partnerships with The Office of Development as part of University Advancement has a mission to maximize philanthropic impact at the University of Oregon. We do this by identifying, connecting and engaging alumni and friends around the globe with their passions to advance the vision and priorities of the university.

Prospect Development is responsible for the implementation of the prospect management system and for the identification of prospects, strategic prospect review and providing intelligence for the purpose of aiding development officers in optimizing portfolios and fundraising to their highest capacity. This department's work is critical to the future success of fundraising at the University of Oregon and the Advancement initiative to identify the next generation of philanthropic leaders. Prospect Development collaborates with each development team and the department as a whole to promote a systematic and quantifiable framework through which development staff manage relationships and to analyze and identify prospects and related strategies.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Management Analyst audits and tracks prospect records while maintaining data integrity throughout the pipeline. Using a comprehensive knowledge of the Prospect Management System, this position reviews and revises policies, procedures, and reports, and engages key stakeholders in discussions and system review. In addition, this position conducts analytics and produces reports on prospect management data that provide essential information to development leadership and stakeholders about development activities and fundraiser performance.

With a customer service focus, the Prospect Management Analyst communicates, provides information, and strategizes with frontline fundraisers and their assistants on a regular basis. This position provides hands-on instruction for data input and information retrieval and plays an integral role in training fundraisers and Advancement staff on Prospect Management System policies.

The ideal candidate for this position will develop an in-depth knowledge of University Advancement’s donor database system that allows them to maintain data integrity by auditing their own work and that of colleagues. This position provides key services to constituents within the department and uses data visualization and analysis to provide information that informs department strategies and metrics. The Prospect Management Analyst should be able to work collaboratively, think independently, and work effectively with a variety of constituents and stakeholders. A PM Analyst that would thrive in this position is one who is detail oriented, enjoys working with large datasets, and can find patterns and impacts within the data to formulate a story of information.

Minimum Requirements

College level courses in statistics (at least six quarter hours); research methods and techniques (e.g., research

design, sampling, surveying, etc.); and computer software application or packages (e.g., Statistical Analyses System, Lotus 1-2-3, etc.);

OR

Three years of experience assisting with the gathering, compiling, analyzing, and reporting of research information and statistical data plus assisting with the drafting of this information into narrative or statistical reports

OR

An equivalent combination of training and experience.

Transcripts must be submitted for all required and/or related courses.

Professional Competencies


Ability to gain in-depth knowledge of a complex database system, including an understanding of how to use, support, modify and train others in the use of database systems.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel and Word.
Ability to exercise independent judgment, as well as operate as a productive team member.
Ability and willingness to work in an environment of frequent interruptions and competing priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including a willingness to proactively reach out to constituents and colleagues in person, via phone, and email.
Ability to build strong relationships with constituents, including developing rapport and trust.
Ability to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to the highest ethical standards.
Ability to interact, communicate, and work effectively with individuals, recognizing and respecting the many and varied identities of each person.
Commitment to promoting and enhancing diversity, equity, and inclusion.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience providing training on complex systems and/or internal policies and procedures.
Experience with Salesforce CRM database..
Experience with Tableau or other data visualization software.
Experience working in higher education development.
Experience in developing and maintaining policies and procedures.


FLSA Exempt: No

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Title: Corporate Advanced Analyst I
Description:
Employment Type

Full-time

Exempt or Non-Exempt

Exempt

Job Summary


Hybrid Work Environment - Must reside on Oahu**



Pay Range: $59,000 - $116,000

Note: Individuals typically begin between the minimum to middle of the pay range

Works independently with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) to be solved; reviews data sources and preps needed data; performs required analysis; applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable; documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used; ensures results have been validated (statistically, if necessary); and prepares/presents findings that are informative and audience appropriate to drive decision making across various levels of the organization.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and four years of related experience or two years of Healthcare Analytics experience; or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
Strong oral and written communicate skills.
Strong understanding of data (types, content reliability, etc.).
Strong problem solving and data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
Strong understanding/use of dashboards, data visualization tools, and advanced and custom graphics.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Including but not limited to Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook.
Proficiency with OLAP tools and databases.
Knowledge of one or more of the following: SQL, R or SAS/SPSS



Duties And Responsibilities


Data Management:
Reviews data sources and preps needed data.
Identifies existing and new data sources.
Performs data prototyping, if necessary, to agree what data can/not be used.
Preps data for use in analysis, goes back to source if problems are found, and identifies other options/alternatives if problems cannot be resolved.
Performs review of data to ensure completeness/accuracy/timeliness for the purpose of the analysis.
Ensures existing, approved, corporate tools used can accept/integrate the data.
Where necessary (and if practical to be done within the delivery timeframe of a project), facilitates the identification and use of new tools and works with the Technical Review Committee to authorize its use.
Analytics and Technical Acumen:
Performs required analysis, applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable, and documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used.
Determines what kind of analytics will be performed (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive) and defines/documents overall framework.
Where appropriate, applies linear regression (correlation, contingency table, ANOVA, inference, chi-square, t-test) and/or time series methods (data set-up, conversions, trends, decomposition, models, forecasts, confidence).
Utilizes appropriate tools to load, integrate, and analyze data.
Conducts analysis and documents findings, identifies unexpected anomalies and root cause (if possible) and determines if analysis can continue, identifies alternatives if anomalies cannot be resolved
Ensures reproducibility of outcomes.
Documents entire analysis process, including business problem, data sources, methods and tools used, project reference, and outcomes.
Implements pre-emptive actions, where possible.
Project Definition and Coordination:
Lead meetings with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) of medium/high complexity and impact (department/function specific, external customer centric, or part of a corporate project).
Types of projects include descriptive and predictive analytics.
Applies a whole company perspective, draws upon previous knowledge and experience, and -- where necessary -- researches new/other approaches to identify and agree upon objectives, approach, and success measures.
Works with customer to submit appropriate paperwork (ISS, TPDR, etc.) and ensures necessary agreements are in place for external customers.
Defines delivery milestones and negotiates timeframes, monitors progress, and periodically notifies customer of status.
Effective Communication:
Works primarily with department heads or function leads to prepare/present findings that are informative and audience appropriate
Reviews findings and outcomes with customer, ensures business problem/objectives have been met, and prepares documentation of the analysis
Where necessary, manage divergent views in the audience and advises the internal/external customer on any recommendations or options that will facilitate data and analysis driven decision making.
Prepares a presentation of the analysis, process followed, and reviews it with the customer to ensure the results are audience appropriate.
Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.
Trains others on MicroStrategy and Excel.
Functions as a team player within the department and embodies collaboration.

Title: Business Systems Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Business Systems Analyst

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

CACI is seeking a Business Systems Analyst to support Shipyard personnel tasked to expedite execution of maintenance availabilities and accelerate on-time delivery of submarines. This position supports the Shipyard solely onsite in HI.

As The Business Systems Analyst, You Will


Leverage your data analytics and dashboard development experience and proven expertise while partnering with Shipyard personnel at all levels of the organization to improve processes, workflow, communications, collaboration, reporting, and supply chains that will lead to increases in Submarine Operational Availability.
Provide subject matter expertise in shipbuilding or ship repair activities, including best practices and lessons learned, that can be applied to reap improvements in Shipyard naval maintenance and modernization activities.
Provide consultation, tools, and methods to aid decision making, project management, and action planning.


Responsibilities


Work collaboratively within a local CACI team and across contractor and customer teams to improve naval maintenance and modernization activities.
Extract data from databases to build metrics, dashboards, and slide deck reports.
Establish and track metrics to determine effectiveness and ensure accountability of stated goals. Perform data collection and analysis.
Design, develop, and update operational and performance metrics and visualization dashboards that measure the status of objectives and their impact on the performance of stated Shipyard measures. Create and deliver slide deck reports and presentations that meet customer needs.
Apply subject matter expertise to determine the highest value-added goals and develop an effective course of action to achieve them.
Facilitate supported teams in taking specific, measurable actions at the agreed upon standard of quality and consistency to drive goal achievement.
Plan, facilitate, lead, and support customer meetings, presentations, briefings, strategic planning sessions, working groups, off-site events, etc. in support of contract activities. This includes pre- and post-administrative support/coordination.
Provide information for various Shipyard management systems.
Support and coordinate with customers in preparation of documentation and deliverables.
Assist Shipyard Trade Shops, Support Codes, and Project Teams in focusing on process improvements that will add the most value to their work.
Establish standards, track highest-performing teams’ behaviors, and share them with across the Naval Maintenance Community.
Develop, maintain, and execute communication strategies that include all customer stakeholders.
Promote accountability through fostering a collective desire to hold each other accountable, celebrate victories, correct problems, and unify the team.
Support the execution of contract requirements, which may include submission of supporting data and metrics and timely completion of written reports to stakeholders, customers, and CACI leadership.
Other duties may be assigned in support of contract taskings and mission success.


Qualifications

Required:


Must be a US Citizen
Must have the ability to obtain a DOD interim Secret and subsequent final DOD Secret security clearance.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. In lieu of the degree requirement, candidates with minimum 10 years of directly applicable work experience may be considered for this position.
Minimum 5 years of experience working in public or private industry Shipyards in the area of shipbuilding, modernization, or ship repair OR in a large commercial repair machine shop OR in a production shop or engineering department.
Extensive experience developing metrics from data mining and developing visualization dashboards using Excel or Power BI tools. High level of proficiency in extracting data from databases to build metrics, dashboards, and slide deck reports.
Expertise in Shipyard best practices with the ability to leverage that expertise and experience to identify best-in-class practices across the shipbuilding and ship repair community.
Demonstrated project management and research skills.
Experience facilitating meetings attended by senior leadership.
Self-starter who is comfortable working in ambiguous situations and in a demanding industrial environment.
Proven leadership ability and demonstrated focus on making the workplace and operating environment higher performing.
Ability to work both independently and within a team to resolve problems.
Strong customer service orientation and written/verbal communication skills with the ability to respectfully engage internal and external customers at all levels in a manner that achieves successful outcomes.
Outstanding organizational skills to efficiently manage competing priorities, multiple concurrent taskings, and firm deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365.


Desired


Active DOD Secret security clearance
Experience working with unions and leading teams of Shipyard skilled workers (e.g., First-Line Supervisor, Work Group Leader, Foreman, Zone Manager).
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Certification in Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, Shingo, or Theory of Constraints.
Experience using cloud-based knowledge management systems (SharePoint, iNFUSION Suite, Jira, etc.).
Knowledge of Naval Shipyard data systems.
Work experience with the Naval Maintenance Community, United States Navy, or the Department of Defense. Experience working with Carrier Planning Activity, SUBMEPP, SHAPEC, PMS312, PMS 392, etc. is preferred.


What You Can Expect

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$71,800 - $150,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Lynden Door in Lynden, WA has an immediate opening for a Reporting Analyst. At Lynden Door we strive to be a relational company that provides world class industry leading quality, value, service, and innovation.

Role Overview

The Reporting Analyst supports business leaders and core team members by maintaining costing, price guides and other sales tools, and by providing timely and accurate reporting and analysis of business operations. The Reporting Analyst will have the opportunity to build momentum in our ongoing transformation of data and enhancing our platforms and business processes.

Do you love turning raw numbers into decisions that actually move a business? We're looking for a Reporting Analyst to be a go-to person for pricing, costing, and performance data across our organization. If you are someone who is confident writing SQL queries and leveraging PowerBI, finds real satisfaction in clean data, performs reasoned analysis, and appreciates high-functioning excel-based business tools, read on!

Hours: Full-time, in-office, 8:00- 5:00 Monday to Friday.

Responsibilities


Perform margin and pricing analysis to support key business initiatives.
Own and maintain Costing Books alongside Estimating, Sales, and Purchasing.
Manage Residential price books — including deep-dive margin and price gap reviews.
Manage Commercial/Architectural Price Guides and multipliers.
Leverage Power BI to create and maintain production reporting.
Work with a broad range of stakeholders to understand and document their data needs.
Establish and maintain connections between data sources and solutions.
Employ reporting and data modeling best practices.
Partner with stakeholders across the company to understand and document their data needs.
Work with Production to build consistent costing methodologies for material, labor, and freight.
Surface margin performance trends tied to mix shifts and volume commitments.
Build ad-hoc reports and dig into data issues — researching root causes, correcting master data, and documenting solutions.
Maintain department KPIs and help evolve how the whole team experiences reporting.


What You Bring


Knowledge and experience writing SQL and leveraging PowerBI.
Strong organizational skills and sharp attention to detail.
A problem-solving, analytical mindset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive data.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across teams and cultures.
A collaborative, service-minded approach to work.


Role

What Makes This Role Rewarding for a Data-Minded Person:


You'll own the numbers that matter. From margin analysis to KPI tracking, your work shapes pricing strategy and business decisions — not just reporting after the fact.
Variety. Solving pricing puzzles, investigating data discrepancies, and translating findings into action across multiple business functions.
Excel is your playground. This role rewards advanced Excel skills — building, modeling, and collaborating at a level that goes well beyond most user's knowledge and ability.
Ad-hoc analysis means chasing down root causes, cleaning up master data, and documenting solutions that stick.
Cross-functional work. Partner with Estimating, Sales, Purchasing, and Production, giving you visibility into how data connects every part of the business.
You'll help shape how the company's platforms and reporting processes grow and improve — not just maintain the status quo.


Compensation And Benefits


Hourly Wage $25 - 32/Hr DOE
Medical/Dental/Vision insurance and Health Savings Accounts (HSA's) with employer contributions $500 - $1,500 annually
401(K) options including profit-share eligibility after 1 calendar year of employment.
8 Paid Holidays
2-3 Weeks Paid Time Off
Paid Bereavement Leave


More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and one of North America's leading manufacturers of quality residential and commercial interior wood doors. The great service and products we deliver are a result of the hard work and talent of our exceptional team. We work very hard to hire the best team members who share our core values in respect for all people, integrity in every situation, and quality in everything we do. A supportive team with diverse backgrounds and career experiences from all around the world strengthens who we are and provides many opportunities for continuous growth and development within our Company.

This job is Safety Sensitive and therefore is contingent upon a pre-employment drug test including marijuana. Additionally due to dealing with sensitive data and systems, a Criminal Background Check will be required for this role.

Title: System and Data Analyst
Description:
Description

This position is open until filled. To ensure consideration, applications should be received by Monday, August 24.

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as an all-tier support for the agencies Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incident; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To


Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Providing technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.


Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. Starting salary is determined by the required qualifications for the role and the candidate’s relevant experience. This is a full-time exempt position working primarily in office Monday through Friday.

We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Up to 26 days of accrued paid time off annually in the first year (13 vacation/13 sick days), and 12 paid holidays. This position is required to participate in Washington PERS (Public Employee Retirement Services).

Requirements

Knowledge and Attributes


Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.


Job Skills

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery
Technical Documentation
Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
Monitoring and Performance Optimization
Regulatory Knowledge
Security Best Practices


Interpersonal & Communication Skills


Customer Service
Verble and Written Communication
Collaboration and Teamwork
Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
Adaptability
Project Management and Organizational Skills


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field, or MIS, or directly relevant experience can be considered in lieu of the required degree.
Four years of demonstrated related work experience. Experience with Microsoft with Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop; Exchange Online, Office 365; SharePoint, Azure Files Services; Azure Active Directory, Windows Service management, and document management and workflow automation software.
Experience administering local and cloud-based computer hardware and telecommunications functions is strongly preferred.
Extensive experience in Yardi required.


A combination of relevant education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the essential functions of the role may be considered in place of the stated requirements.

Application Requirements

To be considered for this opportunity you must:


Complete the online application in its entirety.
Upload a cover letter that addresses how your experience qualifies you to perform the essential functions listed in the job announcement.
Upload a detailed resume of all educational and professional experience.


Final candidates must provide contact information for a direct supervisor to serve as a professional reference.

For more information on the Vancouver Housing Authority, please visit our website at www.vhausa.org. Please note, those candidates deemed to best meet our requirements will be contacted for an interview.

We do not discuss application status during the selection process.

The Vancouver Housing Authority is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Title: Print Supplies Big Data Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, data quality, product data stewardship, monthly reporting operations, and forecasting enablement. In this role, you will partner closely with data engineers, data scientists, and the supplies forecasting teams to ensure data processing pipeline integrity, maintain key business reference and enrichment data, and automate data verification and acceptance processes.

Responsibilities


Own and support monthly validation processes for print telemetry outputs, dashboard semantic layers, and related usage/share reporting handoffs
Serve as a key analytical partner for Forecasting and business stakeholders, helping answer usage, share, installed base, product readiness, and release approval questions through structured analysis and clear communication
Develop and maintain automated and well-documented processes that support recurring validation, issue diagnosis, data quality checks, and stakeholder decision-making
Conduct root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across sources, grains, tables, dashboards, and processing layers, especially where definitions, filters, platform coverage, or reporting timing create mismatches
Provide consultative support for quick-turn ad hoc requests, escalation support, and deep-dive investigations while helping route work through the appropriate intake, prioritization, and transition processes
Collaborate with dashboard, data engineering, and business intelligence partners to improve transparency, repeatability, and maintainability of analytics outputs
Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge, leads, and contributes to complex projects, and exercises independent judgment in resolving business issues and establishing policies
Develops and builds productive internal/external working relationships and may provide mentoring and guidance to lower-level employees


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field.


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics and problem solving: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, metric design, data validation, anomaly detection, and ability to diagnose complex data issues across multiple factors
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, documentation, data lineage, privacy awareness, and the ability to communicate quality risks and remediation paths
Business intelligence and visualization: experience with Power BI, Qlik, advanced Excel, or similar tools to build stakeholder-ready dashboards, analyses, and presentations
Python for data analysis, validation, automation, time-series analysis, reproducible workflows, and tooling to support recurring quality checks and investigations
SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Databricks and modern analytics tooling: ability to work in notebooks, queries, dashboard-supporting datasets, and AI-assisted development environments while maintaining reproducible and reviewable outputs
Forecasting and time-series: ability to support forecasting partners, interpret restatements and metric volatility, and contribute to forecasting automation or time-series analysis workflows
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation (role-dependent)
Strong documentation habits for code and process development, data analyses and investigations, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance. Familiar with version control (e.g., Git), Jira, and Confluence


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity


Impact & Scope


Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.


Complexity


Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for you to join our team as a Data Analyst. This position focuses on data analysis for law enforcement support, requiring a combination of investigative data expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work under high-pressure, mission-critical environments. This role will involve working with diverse data sets, ensuring accuracy and integrity while supporting ongoing criminal and civil investigations.

Our ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with law enforcement agencies. We are looking for more than just a "Data Analyst"—this role requires a technologist with excellent communication skills, customer service, and a passion for data and problem-solving.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis and Trend Recognition Compile and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends across various data sets, locations, and targets.
Data Accuracy and Assessment Monitor data for accuracy, integrity, authenticity, and relevancy. Identify intelligence gaps and assess data viability for investigative purposes.
Investigative Support Collaborate with teams to examine data gathered from criminal and civil investigations, developing methodologies to exploit investigative information.
Quality Control & Reporting Participate in the development of work products, conducting periodic progress reviews and ensuring quality control of findings. Regularly report findings to lead personnel.
