Title: Data Analyst - API
Description:
Company Overview:

Lightspeed is the leading provider of cloud-based software for dealerships, serving the Powersport, Marine, RV, Trailer, and Golf Car industries adding hundreds of dealerships to the Lightspeed community each year.

Lightspeed’s Dealer Management Solution (DMS) enables dealerships to optimize their end-to-end business operations, including Sales, Parts, Service, Rentals, Payments, Accounting, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM). When implemented into their daily operations, Lightspeed helps dealers increase their profitability by selling more units, service, and parts, all while creating a more streamlined experience for customers.

Lightspeed is the most complete and integrated DMS in the industry with over 500 integrations with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), aftermarket parts and accessory distributors and dozens of other software tools that a dealership may use to run their business. Uniquely designed by dealers for dealers, and refined over the past 4 decades, Lightspeed empowers over 4,500+ dealers across North America with the tools and technology they need to manage their dealerships.

We are seeking a Data Analyst - API to maintain the API-based data integrations that connect Lightspeed's DMS platform with OEMs, aftermarket manufacturers, and internal teams. This individual will implement and support RESTful API integrations and reporting solutions, partnering closely with engineering, data platform, and cross-functional teams to keep dealer data flowing accurately across all Lightspeed data platforms.

This role has direct impact on dealer-facing data integrity: the integrations this person builds and maintains determine whether OEM programs, manufacturer data feeds, and dealer reporting are accurate and timely. The role combines hands-on API development with data analysis and reporting and requires close collaboration with internal and external technical stakeholders.

What You'll Do

API Development & Integration


Support and help maintain RESTful API integrations connecting Lightspeed's DMS platform to OEM systems, aftermarket manufacturer data feeds, and internal platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve API connectivity, authentication, and data flow issues for internal and external clients, including OEM and dealer partners.
Document API integration specifications and data mappings for internal and partner-facing use.


Reporting & Data Solutions


Build and support customized reporting solutions using SQL (Microsoft and Postgres) and Power BI.
Perform data classification and validation to ensure accuracy and security across dealer and OEM datasets.


Client & Partner Support


Support internal and external client inbound requests related to API integrations and data feeds.
Collaborate with OEM and aftermarket manufacturer technical contacts to gather and validate integration requirements.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with engineering, data platform, and product teams to meet diverse data requirements across sales, parts, service, rentals, and accounting modules.
Explore and adopt new tools and techniques across SQL, APIs, SSIS, and Power BI.


What You Should Have

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of RESTful API design, development, and integration.
Proficiency with Microsoft SQL; familiarity with PostgreSQL.
Experience with Python, Node.JS, and/or SSIS for building data pipelines.
Exposure to dealer, franchise, or vertical SaaS business models, or strong interest in learning the dealer/OEM data ecosystem.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Power BI or SSRS reporting.
Prior experience integrating with OEM, manufacturer, or partner-facing APIs.
Interest in the Powersports, Marine, RV, Trailer, Outdoor Power Equipment, or Golf Cart industries.

At Lightspeed, we celebrate the uniqueness of every individual and encourage diverse perspectives. We believe that inclusion drives innovation and fosters meaningful connections. We are committed to building an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to make an impact.

Who We Are

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect


Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation


Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.


Reporting Continuity & Analysis


Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.


Data Triage & Corporate Alignment


Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess:


Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.
Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn new business processes and data systems.
Strong affiliation with Price’s core values

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect

  • Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
  • Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
  • Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
  • Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
  • Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
  • Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
  • Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
  • Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
  • Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.

Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation

  • Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
  • Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
  • Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
  • Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
  • Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.

Reporting Continuity & Analysis

  • Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.

Data Triage & Corporate Alignment

  • Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
  • Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
  • Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess:

  • Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
  • Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
  • Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.
  • Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn new business processes and data systems.
  • Strong affiliation with Price’s core values

Description:
The Meaning of More

MOREgroup is a family of architecture, design, and engineering brands that serve civic, education, and healthcare practice areas. The facilities we bring to life are places where communities are cared for, educated, protected, and connected. We are proud to contribute to a strong social infrastructure where generations thrive.

Our beliefs are rooted in the concept of more. We believe the best outcomes happen when we are more connected to the work we do and to the people we serve. What we do matters, but how we do it matters more.

Some of the things you can expect working at MOREgroup…


Contributing to a passionate and energetic team within a growing company.
Training and professional development to support career growth with exposure to a variety of areas and industries.
MORE opportunities to impact the communities we collectively serve.


Position Summary

We are seeking a BIM Analyst to join our Digital Practice – Technology team. This role serves as a technical builder within the Digital Practice, developing automation, integrations, and data-driven solutions that enhance MOREgroup’s design technology ecosystem. The BIM Analyst will turn model data into actionable insights, automate repetitive workflows, and help advance the technical capabilities of both the Digital Practice and Project Delivery teams.

RESPONSIBILITES


Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions using in-house developed add-ins, Python/C#, and the Revit API to streamline production workflows and reduce repetitive effort.
Build and maintain data pipelines that extract, transform, and centralize model and project data from Revit, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and adjacent platforms.
Build and maintain the dashboards and reports that deliver model health, data quality, and practice metrics, to definitions set with BIM Operations and Digital Practice leadership.
Serve as the technical escalation resource for firm-developed tools, add-ins, and automated workflows.
Mentor Coordinator staff in scripting, data practices, and technology workflows; build the team's automation literacy through coaching, training, and documentation.
Analyze BIM data to identify workflow inefficiencies, standards deviations, and opportunities for automation across the practice.
Administer and integrate design technology platforms via APIs (Autodesk Platform Services, ACC) and support interoperability between firm systems.
Evaluate, prototype, and benchmark emerging technologies in support of firm R&D initiatives; document findings and recommend adoption paths.
Maintain technical documentation, deployment packages, and version control for firm-developed tools and scripts.
Partner with the Digital Practice - Services team to gather requirements, pilot solutions with project teams, and support rollout and training.


Qualifications & Skills


Bachelor’s degree in a related field is preferred.
A minimum of 4+ years of experience in AEC design technology, BIM, or software development within a project-based environment.
Proficiency in Python and/or C# with hands-on experience in the Revit API, Dynamo/Grasshopper, and Autodesk Platform Services.
Experience building data visualizations and reports in Power BI or comparable analytics platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate practice needs into technical solutions and coach others in their use.


LOCATION


Ability to work hybrid in one of our offices


Benefits

This role offers competitive compensation and is eligible for participation in our comprehensive benefits programs including:


Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Life insurance, long-term and short-term disability
Employee Assistance Program
Paid time off & paid vacation

Title: Big Data Laser Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary


We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.


Responsibilities


Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.


Preferred Certifications


Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity
Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams


Impact & Scope


Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs


Complexity


Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.


Disclaimer


This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.


Salary

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:


Health insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

Position Summary

The Data Analyst will be primarily responsible for creating and maintaining DMA’s infrastructure and systems that enable the collection, storage, and processing of data. This role is essential for ensuring data is accessible, reliable, and optimized for analysis and decision-making.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from various sources.
Mine data from primary and secondary sources, then reorganize said data in a format that can be easily read by either human or machine
Use statistical tools to interpret data sets, pay particular attention to trends and patterns that could be valuable for diagnostic and predictive analytics efforts
Collaborate with programmers and engineers to improve efficiency and data organization; improve performance through data structure and query optimization
Ensure data integrity, quality, and security across all systems and platforms
Work with departments to provide insight and identify opportunities, improvements, recommend system modifications, and develop policies for data governance
Integrate structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources.
Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows, resolving issues proactively
Design, implement, and maintain critical data systems from ETL/ELT, Data Warehouse, BI Tools, and everything in between
Maintain documentation for data architecture, processes, and standards
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to support data needs.
Analyze requirements from the business and provide solutions or guidance for solutions
Work with senior data analyst to establish data governance


Non-Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or related field.
2 to 5 years’ experience as a data engineering role
Familiarity with professional programming preferred
Familiarity with relevant business domains
Ability to analyze large datasets and write comprehensive reports
Experience in data models and reporting packages
Experience working with data and data analytics development, preferably within the Microsoft data platform
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions
Works effectively with analysts, stakeholders, and IT teams to deliver data solutions that drive business value
Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational and non-relational databases
Proficient with ELT/ETL and Data Warehousing development
Knowledge of relational databases and object-relational mapping concepts
Commitment to data quality, governance, and compliance
Understanding of data modeling, normalization, and schema design
Excellent organizational skills: ability to handle multiple projects
An analytical mind and inclination for problem-solving
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0243644

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to the Navy.

As a client-facing data analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions, conduct research, and develop metrics and strategies to guide enterprise-level software and hardware decisions. You will respond to data calls, combine information from multiple sources, and develop detailed analytical reports that can be clearly communicated to teammates, leadership, and stakeholders. You’ll build dashboards and data visualizations, automate repetitive tasks with scripts, and produce standardized reporting to support enterprise licensing, acquisition documentation, and ongoing program needs.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


4+ years of experience working with the DoW
2+ years of experience with data engineering in Databricks or Spark
2+ years of experience with Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
2+ years of experience performing research, recommending strategies and performance metrics, and supporting business intelligence
Ability to be self-motivated and pay strict attention to detail
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, or Seaborn
Experience performing data science and predictive analytics using tools such as Pandas, Polars, Scikit-learn, MLFlow, Pytorch, or Tensorflow
Experience with federal procurement, including for enterprise software
Experience using Power Platform tools such as Canvas Apps and Power Automate
Knowledge of AI engineering
Databricks, Tableau, or Power BI Certification



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Data Engineer- Analytics
Description:
Old Republic Bitco is seeking a Data Engineer - Analytics to join our Home Office located in Davenport, IA. As a respected specialty insurer with 11 branch offices across 10 states, OR Bitco delivers tailored insurance solutions to complex industries such as construction, forest products, and oil and gas.

This position is open to hybrid work arrangement, blending flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration.

At OR Bitco, our work is guided by core values. We care deeply about our people, partners, and customers. We are committed to excellence and accountability. We deliver on our promises with integrity and precision, and we strive to make a meaningful impact in everything we do. These values drive our mission to protect the people and industries that keep America running.

Join the OR Bitco team and be part of a workplace built on collaboration, open communication, and a positive culture that supports growth and success. If you are passionate about operational excellence and ready to make a measurable impact within a growing, industry-leading organization, OR Bitco offers the platform and challenge you have been seeking.

Position Summary

In this role, you’ll play a key role in building and maturing the Company's Data Services across all aspects of the organization. This includes recommending and implementing tools for enabling internal business units to leverage data securely, effectively, and efficiently.

You’ll develop high-level data analysis, participating in all stages of development from analysis to production releases, delivering data-driven insights to internal business customers. This is a highly collaborative role focusing on Data Services customer needs through data storytelling and insights while modernizing the analytics role for OR Bitco in a cloud-based environment.

You will be involved in all aspects of data science, engineering, and analytics as the Company instills and matures these capabilities and data discipline throughout the organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Collaborate with Project Managers, Business Leaders, Analysts, and other stakeholders to understand the analysis required in order to form data requirements and develop solutions that meet those needs while accommodating scalable volumes of data
Participate in strategic data and analytics projects to enable our business leaders to consume data in a curated self-service model that leads to impactful insights for key business areas
Integrate and deliver data-driven insights and analysis from multiple sources for internal customers to make decisions relevant to their functional area or across product, program, customer, and risk axis
Develop analysis frameworks to enable agile and quick data insights, while maintaining the quality of the insight, and inform strategy
Partner across all operational and support functions to build scalable data-based solutions that provide insights into improving key metrics/OKRs
Work with business leaders to understand market drivers, OKRs, and products to interpret data and make them comprehensible to understand for other teams
Experience with trend analysis and reviews, drafting executive outlines, and recommending strategic changes based on data insights to non-technical leadership teams
Understanding and Experience in Statistical Modeling, Natural Language Processing, GenAI, AIML modeling
Implement automated data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy at scale
Design, build, and maintain robust reporting packages from multiple sources through our data warehouse and analytics marts, ensuring scalability and efficiency
Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of our reporting and analysis system performance and optimize as needed to handle increasing data volumes
Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and reliability across multiple environments (warehouse, data marts, reporting)
Utilize Power BI to create insightful reports, dashboards, and visualizations to provide actionable insights to stakeholders
Troubleshoot data-related issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions in a timely manner to minimize business impact
Create and maintain design documents and documentation for reporting pipelines, semantic models, and processes Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in reporting and data analysis, recommending and implementing improvements as necessary to support scalability and growth
Work closely with various business units and leaders to identify and interpret their data needs, suggesting innovative ways to consume and analyze data
Create reusable templates, such as Power BI semantic models, to empower other data services and IT personnel in their reporting efforts
All other functions and duties as assigned


Qualifications


Legally authorized to work in the United States
3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar reporting role, with a strong background in data analysis, reporting and statistics
Proven work experience with a focus on data storytelling, report development and in-depth data analysis
Solid understanding of data reporting models and communication
Proficiency in Power BI or similar reporting tools, SQL, and experience working with relational databases
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools, such as Snowflake or Microsoft Synapse
Experience with data modeling, semantic model design, and optimization techniques for scalability
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
Self-motivated and proactive, with a passion for continuous learning and professional development


Benefits


Competitive salary paired with a comprehensive benefits package
Generous paid time off, plus 12 paid holidays annually
Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans
Additional protection through accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
Company-paid life insurance equal to 2× annual salary
Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) Savings and Profit-Sharing Plan through Old Republic
Ongoing education, training, and professional development opportunities
Support for industry certifications and insurance designations, including financial assistance
Opportunities to give back through corporate philanthropy and community service initiatives
Optional benefits including travel, commuter, and pet insurance
Employee wellness support through a dedicated fitness program

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re looking for a curious, thoughtful Data Analyst who enjoys turning data into answers that people can actually use.




In this role, you’ll work with different teams to understand what’s happening in the business, dig into the numbers, and help people make better decisions. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with data but also knows that good analysis is about more than spreadsheets—it’s about asking the right questions and explaining what the numbers mean.




You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, improve reporting and processes, and help the team see the bigger picture through data.




What You’ll Do




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and areas that need attention.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and regular business insights.
Work with stakeholders to understand their questions and translate them into practical analysis.
Clean, organize, and validate data to make sure it is accurate and reliable.
Use SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools to explore and communicate findings.
Present your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Work closely with teams across the business to support data-driven decisions.
Look for ways to improve existing reports, processes, and how we use data.
Take ownership of your work while asking questions when you need context or clarification.




What We’re Looking For




Experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL and Excel skills.
Experience with a visualization or BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to problem-solving.
The ability to explain complex information in a simple, clear way.
Good communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams.
A naturally curious mindset—you like to understand the “why” behind the numbers.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.




Nice to Have

Experience with Python or another programming language used for data analysis.
Experience working with large or complex datasets.
Knowledge of statistics and basic analytical techniques.
Experience working with cloud data platforms or data warehouses.
Experience in our industry or with similar business problems.




What You Can Expect




You’ll be joining a team where your work will have a real impact. We value people who are willing to ask questions, share ideas, learn from others, and take ownership of their work.




We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters to us is that you’re willing to learn, think critically, and care about doing good work.




If you enjoy working with data, solving real business problems, and helping people make sense of information, we’d love to hear from you.

Title: Quality Data Analyst
Description:
Careers With Purpose

Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming the health care experience and providing access to world-class health care in America’s heartland.

Facility: Stevens Ctr

Location: Sioux Falls, SD

Address: 900 East 54th St N, Sioux Falls, SD 57104, USA

Shift: 8 Hours - Day Shifts

Job Schedule: Full time

Weekly Hours: 40.00

Salary Range: $24.00 - $38.50

Pay Info: Pay starts at $24 and increases according to years of applicable experience.

Department Details

The Data Engineering team is a collaborative, fun and dynamic group. We strive to innovate and improve the process to bring quality data to our end users.

This role includes a significant emphasis on data engineering quality assurance, including validation of data pipelines, structured testing of data transformations, establishing data quality standards, and ongoing monitoring to ensure accurate and reliable analytics and reporting.

Job Summary

Perform data integration to and maintenance of applicable databases and supporting databases. Independently seek out additional information, knowledge and training to further understand the database system. Learn, understand and analyze process workflows within various functional areas to best understand improvements and associations, specifically with relation to data reporting, extraction and analytics. Design, develop, document, test and deploy custom reports, database smart queries and data exports. Must be knowledgeable and experienced using report writing tools and embrace new responsibilities and change associated with the database. Provide accurate information to support enterprise business, communication and fundraising decisions. Collect, organize, segment, analyze, validate and disseminate significant amounts of information to communicate performance as compared to identified key performance indicators.

Use database reporting environment and complex queries to develop and deploy standard, ad-hoc and custom reports, communications and dashboards in a manner suitable to those receiving it, including both internal and external recipients. Establish and implement processes, including potential automation, to streamline the extraction of data that results in accurate, user-friendly reports, analytics and mass communications. Identify, analyze, research and interpret trends or patterns within complex data sets to provide recommendations and possible solutions. Use logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions that translate to performance measurement, improvement and outcomes.

Use appeal information to monitor and analyze return on investment of various communication activities, including events, mailings and digital communications. Utilize outside sources, including social media and digital analytics, to monitor online engagement and marketing performance. Assist foundation leadership in creating and executing the data management strategy, making recommendations to improve data flow, availability and quality. Work closely with all areas of the organization to develop an understanding of business requirements and goals to provide best service. Proactively seek improvement and monitor feedback to make recommendations for information system modifications needed to support effective and accurate reporting and analysis for the organization.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required. In lieu of education, leadership may accept six years of applicable experience.

Previous experience of two or more years in business, finance, data science, statistics, information management, analytics, fundraising or related field is preferred. Previous experience operating reporting and analytic tools preferred.

Benefits

Sanford offers an attractive benefits package for qualifying full-time and part-time employees. Depending on eligibility, a variety of benefits include health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, work/life balance benefits, and a generous time off package to maintain a healthy home-work balance. For more information about Total Rewards, visit https://sanfordcareers.com/benefits .

Sanford is an EEO/AA Employer M/F/Disability/Vet. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation for help with your online application, please call 1-877-673-0854 or send an email to talent@sanfordhealth.org .

Sanford has a Drug Free Workplace Policy. An accepted offer will require a drug screen and pre-employment background screening as a condition of employment.

Title: Data Services Analyst
Description:
The Data Services Analyst delivers custom data solutions that help DMSi customers maximize the value from their ERP solution. This role works across a broad and growing set of technologies, including custom reporting, business intelligence dashboards, data transformations, and system integrations. The right candidate is execution-focused, intellectually curious, and eager to grow alongside an expanding technology stack. They will bring a strong aptitude for problem-solving, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in using AI tools to work smarter and help the team build more efficient workflows.




RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

Evaluate and manage customer requests using internal systems, including the ability to scope, quote, design a solution, and execute on the project plan.
Develop and deliver custom data solutions, including report writing, data extractions, forms customization, business intelligence dashboards, and system integrations.
Use AI tools and assistants as a standard part of daily work to increase efficiency and contribute to the team’s development of AI-assisted workflows and internal tooling
Build proficiency in DMSi’s evolving product and integration ecosystem, including current and emerging platforms.
Develop and maintain an advanced working knowledge of DMSi’s internal support tools and delivery processes.
Assist other DMSi personnel through escalation support, coaching, and training on data-related topics.
Complete documentation related to job responsibilities and contribute to the DMSi Knowledge Base.
Lead, attend, or assist with training for internal personnel, customers, and prospects.
Assist with internal projects to support departmental and organizational objectives.




KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Technical: SQL/query proficiency (Cyberquery a plus), BI tools (Power BI, Phocas, Tableau, etc.), ETL/data lineage and database fundamentals (schemas, indexes, keys).

Analytical: Genuine curiosity paired with strong problem-solving, research, and the ability to work independently through ambiguous business challenges.

AI-forward: Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to speed up and improve work quality.

Quality-focused: High attention to detail, diagnoses issues correctly and validates solutions before customers see them.

Technical collaboration: Familiar with integration/automation (Workato or similar), comfortable with code reviews and tools like GitHub.

Execution: Prioritizes well, works under pressure, hits deadlines.

People skills: Communicates clearly, builds relationships across all levels (including customers/vendors), exercises tact and keeps confidentiality.




EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

College degree in Data Science, Computer Information Systems (CIS), Management Information Systems (MIS), Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related discipline preferred; 3-5 years of equivalent work experience in a relevant field will be considered.




WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Normal office environment with use of computers and telephone systems; no unusual physical demands.

Travel as needed, including business air travel and car rental.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Data Analyst, Mid
Description:
Job Number: R0246792

Data Analyst, Mid

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to support Navy Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst on our Navy Supply Operations team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on education, resources, trainings, and policies to ensure sailors receive proper awareness to form career-forwarding decisions.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience in a professional work environment
Experience presenting data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using databases and scripting languages
Experience preparing customer data for models, including merging and aggregating data, handling anomalies, balancing, and feature selection
Experience establishing quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes
Experience applying data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, and PowerPoint slides
Ability to research, develop, and test data methodologies
Ability to support client and stakeholder relationships, conceptualize directions, analyze trends, and develop justifications for Navy leadership decisions
Ability to contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making by applying communications, validation, and research to simplify technical requirements and trends for varied audiences
Secret clearance
HS diploma or GED



Nice If You Have:


Knowledge of building and maintaining workflows, visualizations, and other Premium Microsoft Services databases in the Microsoft enclaves and ADVANA, Jupiter, or BOLT enclave, including Databricks, Qlik, Tableau, and Power BI
Bachelor's degree



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Description

Data Analyst

Associate III - Data Engineering

Who We Are

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

You Are

UST is seeking a product-oriented Data Analyst to design, analyze, and operationalize data objects, data quality rules, and analytics frameworks that drive pricing, search, and operational performance at scale.

The Opportunity


Analyze, document, and design data objects, dimensional models, and data quality rules for analytics and reporting use cases.
Ensure governance, compliance, documentation, and explainability across all data assets and analyses
Monitor and analyze key KPIs across business including established SLAs
Run Pricing and Search frameworks
Diagnose pricing vs. search vs. supply related performance issues through structured, hypothesis driven deep dive analysis.
Produce insights that inform operational levels, readiness for large sales events, and configuration changes.


This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need


Experience range: 4-6 years of experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field
3+ years of experience in data design, dimensional modeling, and analytics
Proven ability to work effectively both independently and in cross functional teams.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong customer focus with a high bar for quality and accuracy.
Ability to thrive in a fast paced, agile development environment.


Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Arkansas

Compensation Range: $62,000-$93,000

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as the following Company-paid Employee Only benefits: basic life insurance, accidental death and disability insurance, and short- and long-term disability benefits. Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits, and participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA) as well as a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines. Benefits offerings vary in Puerto Rico.

Part-time employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.

Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) program with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

What We Believe

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

Humility

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

Humanity

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

Integrity

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Business Intelligence Solutions Developer
Description:
Summary

Provides Business Intelligence (BI) solution support through the development, deployment, integration, and support of advanced analytical tools. Works closely with requestors and/or analytical/development peers to prepare and/or review detailed specifications from which solutions are developed. Responsible for the design, coding, testing, debugging and documentation throughout the development process. Evaluates and supports organizational needs and applies BI tools/visualization techniques to transform data into actionable information

Essential Functions

Develop BI solutions and tools in support of TMC customer needs.

Support the Implementation and Training of new BI Solutions.

Learns and follows new tools/visualization techniques to support customers’ needs.

Monitor use of BI solutions and identifies usage inconsistent with customer business requirements .

Write BI solutions using the most appropriate languages for the specific feature or use case.

Identify, debug, and remedy problems within BI solution sets.

Develop, design, and interpret use case specifications.

Follow project scope, development timelines, and established design standards.

Adhere to and supports team members in exhibiting TMCH values of integrity, community, compassion, and dedication.

Adhere to TMC organizational and department-specific safety, confidentiality, values, policies and standards.

Perform related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION : Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business intelligence, STEM, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

EXPERIENCE: Three (3) years of BI solutions development and analysis experience, preferably in an acute care setting.

LICENSURE OR CERTIFICATION : Certification in one or more EPIC applications preferred.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Knowledge of database management systems.
Applied experience with SQL.
Applied experience in BI technologies (Qlik, PowerBI, Lumira, BOBJ, R, SAS, Python).
Knowledge of design in custom data models and algorithms using data science or advanced analytical methodologies.
Knowledge of application programming and a good understanding of the business process for which the application is designed.
Knowledge of how to evaluate systems and develop scope and document system needs.
Skill in documenting and trouble shooting and defining system scope to accurately analyze needs for improvement.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret scientific and technical journals, extensive financial reports, and/or legal documents.
Ability to calculate figures and compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs; ability to apply basic algebraic concepts
Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
Ability to deal with nonverbal symbolism (formulas, scientific equations, graphs, etc.), and with a variety of abstract and concrete variables.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: London, ON | Hybrid/Remote | StarTech.com

StarTech.com is continuing to grow our Data Analytics team and we are looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about turning data into actionable insights.

In this role, you will partner closely with cross functional teams to analyze data across key areas of the business, including product performance, inventory, revenue, customer insights, and marketing. Your work will help shape business decisions, optimize performance, and support continued growth.

You will be responsible for transforming data from multiple sources into clear, meaningful insights, building models, and delivering reporting that informs strategy. Success in this role comes from strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights in a way that drives action.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with data tools such as Power BI, Python, R, or Excel, and collaborating with stakeholders to influence outcomes, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Posting this opportunity to support a backfill requirement on the team

What You’ll Do

Analyze key business metrics to evaluate and improve strategic initiatives
Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations
Build data models and generate summary statistics using analytics tools
Develop reports and dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Power BI)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business needs
Communicate insights clearly to stakeholders at all levels
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve efficiency
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Technology, or related field (Master’s in Analytics is an asset)
2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role working with large datasets
Strong experience with Power BI and Power Query
Advanced Excel skills
Intermediate proficiency in Python or R
Experience or interest in AI tools and applications

What Sets You Apart

Strong data cleaning, transformation, and analysis skills
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights
Experience building queries, reports, and visualizations
High attention to detail and accuracy
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
A proactive learner who is curious, adaptable, and driven to improve processes

Why Join StarTech.com?

Competitive salary and bonus potential
Comprehensive benefits package
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Opportunities to grow your skills in analytics, BI, and AI

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

Intro call with our Talent Acquisition Team (30 minutes)
Assessment (60 minutes)
Interview with the Hiring Manager (45-60 minutes)
Final Interview - Director, Market Research & Analytics (45 minutes)
Offer & onboarding

This role offers a competitive salary range of CAD $68,000 to $78,000 and eligibility to participate in our bonus program. At StarTech.com, we value fairness and regularly benchmark pay to stay competitive, recognizing each person’s unique contributions.

As part of the StarTech.com “One Team,” you’ll also enjoy:

Comprehensive health benefits
Tuition reimbursement program
Retirement savings plans
Wellness Program
Additional perks and rewards

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines, analytics systems, and reporting solutions. The analytics engineer also models raw data into clean, tested, and reusable datasets to allow business stakeholders to view and understand data in a warehouse or database.

Qualifications (Required & Preferred):

Education: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, or related field (R)

Experience: At least five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, software engineering, or a similar role (R); Expertise in data modeling, ETL development, and data analysis (R)

Skills: Strong ability in SQL for data extraction and manipulation, and proficiency in data warehousing concepts/tools such as Targit, Ignite, and Power BI; Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure for data storage and processing; Substantial programming ability using languages/tools such as C++ & .NET for data manipulation and scripting; Solid understanding of relevant data governance, data quality, and data security best practices; Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to think critically and analytically; Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and data warehousing concepts.; Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Targit & Power BI; Knowledge of upgrading data systems like Targit; Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and present insights to business stakeholders (all R).

Role Responsibilities:

Delivers well-defined, transformed, tested, documented, and code-reviewed datasets for analysis
Builds data aggregation pipelines using SQL, .NET, Targit, Power BI
Creates robust data models and architectures to support analytics initiatives
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their analytics needs and deliver comprehensive reports, dashboards, and models
Identifies and implements optimizations to continually enhance query performance, reduce processing time, and increase overall productivity
Designs, develops and maintains data pipelines to ensure efficient and reliable ETL processes
Implements and maintains analytics systems, data warehouses, or data lakes to store and manage structured and unstructured data
Creates and maintains dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools such as Targit & Power BI to enable data-driven decision-making
Collaborates with Data Analytics Manager to incorporate Power BI and data governance across the organization
Ensures data quality and accuracy by implementing data validation, monitoring, and error-handling processes
