Title: Analyst, Business Analysis
Description:
The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves uncovering insights hidden in data? We’re looking for an Analyst, Business Analysis to join our Finance team within Insurance Services. In this role, you’ll collaborate with teams across AMA to turn complex information into meaningful insights that help guide sound business decisions. You’ll analyze trends, process and products, and bring clarity to big questions — all while helping us make smarter, data-driven choices that serve our members better. In this role, you will also be supporting the corporate reserving function, to support informed business decisions across pricing, underwriting, reinsurance, and capital management.

A Place to Belong

AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

About

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:


Competitive salary and flexible benefits
Employer-paid retirement savings program
Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
Free travel medical insurance for you and your immediate family
Ongoing professional development
Paid vacation and personal days, including a Volunteer Day and Me Day
Flexible work models that make sense for your lifestyle


Who You Are


A curious, analytical thinker who loves solving complex problems with data.
A strong communicator who can translate numbers into meaningful business stories.
Naturally collaborative — you enjoy working across teams to find solutions that make an impact.
Detail-oriented, organized, and confident managing multiple priorities.
You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where innovation and teamwork drive results.


How You’ll Make An Impact


Provide data-driven support to guide action-oriented business decisions across AMA.
Analyze and interpret data from multiple sources to identify key trends and opportunities.
Develop and manage high-quality dashboards and reporting solutions that serve as a single source of truth.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather, validate, and refine business requirements.
Present findings and insights to leadership teams in clear, compelling ways.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of critical data.
Support the rollout of new business analytics tools and processes.


What You Bring To The Table


Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in actuarial analysis, business intelligence, business analysis, or a related technical role.
Advanced working knowledge of SQL (including complex query writing).
Experience developing and managing BI solutions or dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
Strong data visualization and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
Familiarity with data management languages (Python, R) and experience in the insurance industry are strong assets.
Experience in the insurance industry is preferred.
Actuarial reserving experience would be an asset.


Belonging Matters Here

AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@ama.ab.ca. We’ll work with you to ensure you feel supported throughout your journey with us.

Work Model

Hybrid

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Recruitment Details

Data Scientist

Department: Winnipeg Police Service

Designated Work Location: 245 Smith Street, On-site

Position Type: Permanent, Full-time

Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 0800 - 1600

Salary: $3,977.94 - $4,812.58 bi-weekly

Employee Group: Winnipeg Police Association (WPA)

Posting No: 127306

Closing Date: Friday, September 18th, 2026

Providing a wide range of services to over half of all Manitobans, The City of Winnipeg is one of the largest employers in Manitoba. We provide a comprehensive range of benefits and career opportunities to our employees. These include competitive salaries, employer-paid benefits, dental and vision care, pension plans, and maternity/parental leave programs. Additionally, we offer education, training, and staff development opportunities to ensure that our employees are equipped with the necessary skills to advance in their careers.

Our Benefits web page provides detailed information about the benefits we offer, and we encourage you to visit it for further information at City of Winnipeg Benefits . We take pride in fostering a , diverse , safe, and healthy workplace where our employees can thrive and achieve their full potential.

The City is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse, skilled workforce that is representative and reflective of the community we serve. Applications are encouraged from equity groups that have been and continue to be underrepresented at the City; Indigenous Peoples, Women, Racialized Peoples, Persons with Disabilities, 2SLGBTQQIA+ Peoples and Newcomers are encouraged to self-declare.

Requests for Reasonable Accommodation will be accepted during the hiring process.

Preference to internal applicants may be applied.

Job Profile

Under the general direction of the Senior Data Scientist, the Data Scientist is responsible for conducting large-scale and targeted statistical data analysis to identify trends and deliver, reports to both management and project stakeholders.

The Data Scientist leads the design, implementation, and integration of complex data systems and sources, oversees the development of advanced analytics models, and creates interactive dashboards and visualizations to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Leveraging deep knowledge of industry best practices and providing subject matter expertise, the Data Scientist fosters a data-driven culture and strengthens the organization's ability to accurately collect, analyze, and deliver actionable insights to support informed decision-making.

In the absence of the Senior Data Scientist, the Data Scientist may assume temporary oversite responsibilities of the section.

As a Data Scientist You Will


Conduct large-scale and targeted statistical data analysis to identify trends, support critical decision making, and for reporting to both management and project participants.
Lead the development, implementation, and integration of new and existing data sources, applications and reporting mediums.
Contribute subject matter expertise to promote a data culture within the organization and enhance organization-wide capacity for accurately collecting, analyzing, and acting on data.
Research and apply best data science practices to ensure accurate, efficient and scalable solutions aligned with industry standards and business goals.
Other duties as assigned


Your Education And Qualifications Include


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Statistics or related field.
Certificate in Business Intelligence is an asset.
Master's Degree is an asset.
Minimum 48 months progressive experience in:
SQL, RStudio, and/or Python
Statistical Analysis System (SAS), Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS), or other equivalent tools
Data analytics, interpretation of data and statistical modelling
Minimum 48 months experience with databases, performing Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) from various data sources, and data warehousing integration including organizing, compiling, manipulating, analyzing and summarizing large datasets.
Experience with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or Neural Networks is an asset.
Knowledge of operational process asset management principles and practices and ability to integrate data science for the effective and efficient use within the Service's investment planning process.
Knowledge of project management principles and the ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate and facilitate activities as assigned.
Knowledgeable in utilizing data repositories and integrating open-source programming and tools to address specific requirements.
Practical experience with graphic design principles for Power BI dashboard creation.
Skilled in using business intelligence platforms and tools such as Power BI SAS, SPSS, Power Query, and Data Analysis Expressions (DAX).
Proficient in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geospatial and Location Intelligence (GLI), including cartography and mapping techniques.
Demonstrated advanced level proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
Demonstrated ability in data collection, writing summaries, and visualizing data.
Proven history of advising senior leadership and driving efficiency and improvement through innovative solutions and successful project execution .
Ability to conduct research, analyze complex issues and make recommendations based on sound judgement.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent organizational abilities with a proactive, initiative-driven approach.
Strong ability to multi-task and perform effectively under time constraints.
Excellent oral and written communication skills , and the ability to present research findings effectively to varying audiences.
Demonstrated interpersonal skills and the ability to work cooperatively, collaboratively, and professionally with fellow employees at all levels, consultants and external stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and build and maintain relationships with the team and others within the organization

Description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Bring your unique skills, thrive with interesting and challenging work, and experience what it’s like at Home. Apply today - this is a great opportunity to join a proudly Canadian company that is 100% ready to help you build your future.

A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

Job Summary

Responsible for gathering disparate data files from various sources. Analyze and normalize to ensure quality and process for upload into the master data management or other related software. Title: Data Analyst Engineer
Description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic Data & Analytics team, within the Platforms & Transformation group. The Data Engineer will use their technical, analytical and insurance expertise while working as part of project teams to deliver the benefits to AXIS. This is an excellent opportunity to work within great teams across the business on complex, challenging and rewarding projects and initiatives to build towards the success of AXIS.

What will you do in this role?

Data Analysis & Modelling:


Work with the business teams, including senior leaders, to define the data products and use cases along with their data lineage, critical data elements, data glossaries and data quality rules.
Work with the Data Architecture team to enable the design of best-in-class current state and future state data flow diagrams
Partner with the Data Insights and AI & Innovation teams to design the outputs and workflows for Use Cases and Data Products.
Use your industry experience to define the metrics required for projects and solutions.
Lead the QA testing of data products and supporting the business teams during UAT.
Support the future phases of data products you have delivered in projects once live where you are considered a subject matter expert and have a relationship with the business teams.



Data Engineering:


Run simple and complex queries to understand existing data structures and relationships, data quality gaps and metric formulas to enable accurate documentation of the current state solutions.
Use your advanced Excel skills to reverse engineer complex workbooks with macros and layered formulas to enable modular redesign in our modern data architecture.
Build and execute test models against both on-premises SQL Server and Azure Databricks databases.
Work closely with the development teams to ensure your data product templates are clearly defined to the specifications required by the application delivery leads.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.



About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused role.
Very strong SQL and Excel experience
Design experience with star schemas and delta concepts
Experience in data modelling in Excel having worked within Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to understanding data quality issues and challenges
Experience with large complex projects delivering data products and use cases
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to time manage and work across different priorities.



What we prefer you to have:


Insurance industry experience.
Microsoft SQL Server and Azure Databricks experience
Ability to read programming languages
Knowledge of Insurance KPIs and metrics and processing within Underwriting, Claims and Pricing
Experience taking a key role on Data & Analytics projects



Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

This position is a hybrid role and will require mandatory in office presence 3 days per week.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $75,000 - $120,000 CAD (Nova Scotia). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Alberta Blue Cross is looking for a Finance Data Analyst to join our Financial Planning & Analysis team. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Permanent Full Time

We are looking for Senior Analysts to join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics & Reporting team. We are currently hiring for multiple Senior Data Analyst roles and are seeking candidates with experience across one or more of the following skill sets:

We’re hiring for experience in the following areas:


Senior BI Analyst – Core BI delivery focused on requirements, KPI definition, analysis, and Power BI reporting using curated datasets
Senior BI Specialist – End‑to‑end delivery specialists combining advanced Power BI development with strong data‑engineering capability, owning solutions from discovery through build, validation, and rollout
Senior Data Foundation Analyst – Data‑engineering–focused role responsible for building, enriching, and governing data pipelines and datasets that enable downstream BI and analytics


As a Senior Analyst you will join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the ideation, development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics is a data subject matter expert enhancing decision making, monitoring business performance, providing actionable insight, and driving operational efficiencies using advanced analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will model, analyze, and predict complex business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will oversee and support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements; collect, integrate, clean, model, and analyze large datasets; and visualize and present insights to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Use Azure Databricks and advanced SQL to transform and model data, and Power BI to deliver governed, insight‑driven reporting and analytics solutions
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Apply strong communication, influence, and strategic thinking to shape analytics solutions and drive business decisions
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Oversee and support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Assist the business in the ideation of new analytics initiatives ranging from descriptive, diagnostic, predictive to prescriptive
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner
Retrieve, integrate, and transform data from multiple systems using SQL, Python, and other scripting languages


What You Will Bring


3-5 years of relevant experience and a master’s degree in related field of study, or an equivalent combination of bachelor’s degree and extensive related experience
Strong experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualization tools (Power BI) with demonstrated experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write complex and efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate and transform data from multiple sources and automate data pipelines
Advanced skills in Power BI, Data Modeling, Power Query, and DAX
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL‑300) certification preferred
Strong experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling
Polished communication and presentation skills to audiences including senior leadership
Strong analytical skills for problem solving and to monetize value for the organization
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instruction
Think outside the box and identify solutions to overcome obstacles
Proven ability to learn and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset
Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life.


The base salary for this position is between $80,400 - $130,400 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Title: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist
Description:
POSITION TITLE: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Finance, Administration & Information Technology

CLASSIFICATION: MGO-07

SALARY RANGE: Starting at $79,591.00 Per Annum

POSITION TYPE: Full-time, Permanent

LOCATION: Saskatoon

ACCOUNTABLE TO : Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT

Brief Overview

The Financial Database & Analytics Specialist is responsible for the profiling, development, integration, and optimization of enterprise databases and reporting solutions that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, performance measurement, and operational analysis. This position serves as the government's technical specialist in database profiling, data availability, systems integration, business intelligence, and analytical reporting, helping transform data from multiple systems into reliable information for decision-making across government.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Compliance, Governance & Risk Management


Profiles, develop, maintains, and optimizes enterprise databases, data models, and reporting structures that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, operational analysis, and performance measurement.
Supports the integration of data across finance, payroll, human resource, procurement, project management, funding agreement, and other government systems.


Financial Analysis & Decision Support


Provides technical and analytical support for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, funding agreement reporting, trend analysis, key performance indicators, and executive reporting.
Works closely with Finance to ensure reliable information is available to support financial planning, resource allocation, reporting obligations, and decision-making.


Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence


Develops and maintains reports, dashboards, data extracts, automated reporting solutions, and analytical models that support government-wide reporting requirements.
Translate business requirements into practical database structures, queries, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that improve accessibility and use of information while maintaining data security, privacy protection standards.


Data Quality, Automation & Continuous Improvement


Improves the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and accessibility of enterprise data used for financial and operational reporting.
Identifies opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring reporting requirements, reduce manual effort, and improve the efficiency of data collection and analysis activities across government.


Technical Documentation, Collaboration & Advisory Support


Develops and maintains technical documentation related to databases, data models, data flows, and system integrations.
Works collaboratively with ministries, departments, program areas, internal consulting teams, external consulting teams, Information Technology, and system vendors to assess data availability, recommend appropriate data structures and classifications, and support reporting and analytical requirements.
Other duties as assigned by the Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong proficiency in SQL, data extraction, transformation, and reporting development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate reporting requirements into technical solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and financial data analysis tools.
Ability to assess data availability, relationships, and appropriate categorization across multiple systems.
Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, performance measurement, and government reporting environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years progressive financial analysis, database development or relevant experience.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, or equivalent.
An equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and progressively responsible experience may be considered


Additional Requirements


Must undergo a Criminal Record Check
Valid Saskatchewan driver’s license and access reliable transportation
Please submit your application by 9:59 PM on August 27, 2026.

Title: Analytics Developer
Description:
A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.

We're a talented, tight-knit team that's fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.

To learn more, visit formswim.com

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can contribute quickly, take ownership of production work and leave well-tested, documented systems and intuitive reporting behind.

Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt
Experience working with a cloud data warehouse; Amazon Redshift and AWS experience are preferred
Experience using Git, code review and software development practices in an analytics environment
Working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, integrations or automation
Experience with Tableau or another modern business intelligence platform
Ability to troubleshoot data issues across source systems, transformation pipelines and downstream reporting
Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, maintainable data solutions


Nice to Haves


Experience with Dagster, Airflow or another workflow orchestration platform
Experience with Fivetran or other managed data ingestion tools
Experience with subscription, ecommerce, product telemetry or financial data
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or consumer technology environment


We thank you for your interest in FORM and to everyone who took the time to apply for this position, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

FORM is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of diversity and inclusion. We recognize that we are better able to achieve our goals and live our core values when we have a diverse team of employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment. We welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, race, colour, place of origin, religion, family status, marital status, physical or mental disability, sex, age, sexual orientation, or political beliefs.

Benefits


Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
Paid Time Off Benefits
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program - Counselling


This role has an annual salary range of $90,000 to $110,000. Most new hires do not start at the top of the range. Compensation is determined based on a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role.

Candidates who are newer to this level of responsibility but demonstrate strong potential may receive an offer toward the lower end of the range. Offers at the higher end are typically reserved for candidates with extensive, directly relevant experience and a proven track record of success in comparable roles and environments.

Eastlink

In this role, you'll support our Customer Care and Accounts Receivable teams by providing analysis that helps leaders understand performance and anticipate future business needs. Monitor and analyze key operational, customer service, and Accounts Receivable metrics.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance scorecards.
Present findings in a clear way to help teams prioritize actions and achieve results.
Support forecasting, workforce planning, and sales performance tracking.
Partner with leaders to evaluate challenges, answer business questions, and recommend solutions.
Contribute to improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and support business goals.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with information, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions. You’ll succeed in this role if you:

Are naturally curious and enjoy understanding the story behind the numbers.
Take ownership of your work and can confidently manage priorities independently.
Approach challenges with strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
Can identify trends, evaluate impacts, and make well-supported recommendations.
Are comfortable working with both detailed information and the bigger business picture.
Build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with different teams.
Communicate clearly and can adjust information to different audiences.
Have a strong commitment to accuracy, quality, and continuous learning.




What You’ll Bring

Three or more years of experience in an analytical, financial, operational, or business support role.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with large and complex datasets.
Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and interpreting business data.







Strong reporting and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate findings effectively.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst – Leading Client




Our client is a rapidly growing organisation undergoing an exciting period of transformation, with data becoming increasingly central to how the business operates and makes decisions. They are investing in their data and BI capabilities and are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to help build a trusted, scalable reporting environment.




The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of Power BI reporting across the business. You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders and business teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights, while helping establish consistent data models, KPIs, and reporting standards.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the full analytics lifecycle — from sourcing and modelling data through to building dashboards, developing advanced DAX and Power Query logic, and presenting insights to decision-makers.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain high-quality Power BI dashboards across multiple areas of the business.
Own the end-to-end reporting process, from understanding business requirements through to data modelling, development, testing, and deployment.
Develop robust and reusable semantic data models using strong data modelling principles.
Use Power Query and DAX to transform data and create advanced business metrics and reporting logic.
Write SQL queries to source, analyse, and combine data from multiple systems.
Define and standardise KPIs with business stakeholders to create a consistent view of performance.
Replace fragmented spreadsheets and legacy reporting with scalable, self-service BI solutions.
Analyse data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and areas for business improvement.
Implement appropriate reporting permissions and data access controls.
Work with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting adoption, and self-service analytics.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Ciao, siamo Subito! 🚀

Hai presente quell'app che quasi ogni italiano ha installata sul telefono? Ecco, quella è casa nostra. Subito è il marketplace leader in Italia: un posto dove milioni di persone comprano, vendono e danno una seconda vita agli oggetti ogni giorno. Siamo un brand amato, con una valutazione di 4.8 stelle e una community vastissima, ma non ci sediamo sugli allori. Vogliamo trasformare ogni singolo dato in un'opportunità per rendere l'esperienza dei nostri utenti sempre più fluida, sicura e intelligente.


Il tuo posto nel team Data

Stiamo cercando un Senior Data Analyst che abbia la passione per i numeri e la capacità di trasformarli in narrazioni efficaci. Entrerai a far parte del team Data Analytics, il cui compito è estrarre valore dai dati per comprendere a fondo il mercato italiano. Studierai il comportamento degli utenti, valuterai le iniziative strategiche e sperimenterai nuove feature. Soprattutto, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto diretto sulla crescita del nostro business.



Job Requirements

Cosa andrai a fare?

In Subito, i dati non sono solo numeri, ma la bussola che guida ogni nostra decisione:

Genererai Insight ad alto valore: Analizzerai i dati per supportare il business con insights rilevanti (funnel analysis, trend e pattern comportamentali) e presenterai i risultati agli stakeholder.

Democratizzerai il dato: Progetterai report e dashboard automatizzate e intuitive, permettendo a tutta l'azienda di accedere ai dati in modo semplice e immediato.

Modellerai il business: Imparerai a conoscere e aiuterai a progettare il nostro Data Lake per estrarre il massimo valore possibile dai dati e modellare al meglio le nostre logiche di business (data modeling).

Sperimenterai sul campo: Formulerai ipotesi e progetterai esperimenti per valutare l'impatto reale delle nuove feature sui nostri utenti.

Sarai un partner strategico: Collaborerai con gli stakeholder per raccogliere i requisiti e rispondere alle loro domande con l'approccio analitico più efficace.



Job Responsibilities

Come lavoriamo? (Spoiler: amiamo l'eccellenza tecnica)

Abbiamo costruito un ecosistema moderno dove il dato è al centro di tutto:

Tecnologia allo stato dell'arte: Lavoriamo su architettura AWS, utilizzando strumenti per l'estrazione, la manipolazione di dati su larga scala (SQL, Spark, Pandas/Polars).

Cultura del dato: Lavoriamo con il framework OKR (Objectives and Key Results) per garantire che ogni nostra azione sia allineata agli obiettivi aziendali.

Statistica Applicata: Andiamo oltre l’analisi descrittiva; utilizziamo regressioni, analisi delle serie storiche e statistica bayesiana per generare insights profondi e scenari predittivi ad alto impatto.

Data Storytelling: Crediamo che un'analisi sia utile solo se comunicata bene; per questo curiamo molto la visualizzazione e la presentazione dei dati.




Sei la persona giusta se...

Hai più di 5 anni di esperienza come Data Analyst in contesti complessi.

Sei un asso nell'estrazione e manipolazione di dati (SQL, Spark, Pandas, Polars...).

Hai un'ottima conoscenza di Python o R.

La statistica applicata non ha segreti per te (regressioni, ANOVA, analisi serie storiche, etc.).

Sai come trasformare un'analisi complessa in un racconto avvincente.




Bonus points (le ciliegine sulla torta):

Hai esperienza con Tableau e tool di tracciamento (Google Analytics, Snowplow...).

Sai come condurre A/B testing su feature di prodotto.

Hai già lavorato in aziende digitali o su progetti di Data Science.




Job Benefits

Cosa ti offriamo? 🎁

Vogliamo che tu sia stimolato e valorizzato. Il benessere in Subito è un pacchetto completo:

Compensazione & Crescita: RAL 40-55K bonus annuali e opportunità di formazione continua.

Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida, con due giorni a settimana in presenza e tre da remoto. Ci trovi in via Angelo Scarsellini 14 (fermata M3 Affori Centro): abbiamo creato un ufficio open space super luminoso e pieno di comfort, perfetto per collaborare dal vivo ma con tutta la flessibilità di cui hai bisogno. La distanza è troppa? Valutiamo l'opzione del full-remote per casi specifici direttamente durante il processo di interview.


Inclusività in Subito

In Subito accogliamo le persone per quello che sono. La diversità in ogni sua forma — genere, età, nazionalità o orientamento — è la nostra benzina creativa e ci aiuta a crescere insieme.




Ti senti pronto/a? Se hai voglia di far parlare i dati e costruire il futuro del marketplace leader in Italia, inviaci il tuo CV. Non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti! L'iter di selezione prevede:

Quick call con HR

Technical Test & Deep Dive con il Data Team

Call con Head of Data Analytics

Final call con HR e VP of Data & AI (soft skills & values fit)




Cosa aspetti? La tua nuova avventura inizia QUI.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate data analyst with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.


Design, build and monitor data models & dashboards to track business metrics
Work with cross-functional teams to identify key business needs and solve them using adequate statistical models
Thoroughly document your results and offer onboarding and continuous training to help teams effectively utilize data and insights.
Establish data quality processes to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machine learning models.
Promote data literacy within the organization and serve as the primary point of contact for all data-related inquiries and support.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills to efficiently manage senior stakeholders within a fast-paced scale-up environment.
Work closely with the central data team to source additional data and enhance data management practices


Profile


At least 4 years' experience in Data Analysis
Proficient with SQL and/or Python, with a proven experience working with large and complex data sets.
Autonomous person with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
Experience with statistical modeling & predictive analytics
Excellent verbal & written communication abilities
Experience building dashboards with Tableau.
Experience in gaming industry or mobile marketing is a plus
Any personal or professional experience with machine learning will be valued


Our Stack

SQL; Python; DBT; AWS; Tableau

Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Till Trygg-Hansa Företagsmarknad söker vi nu en Senior Data Analyst som vill vara med och ta organisationens BI- och analysfunktion till nästa nivå.

Om jobbet | Ta data till insikter som gör skillnad för affären

Som Senior Data Analyst får du en nyckelroll i att driva utvecklingen av BI, analys och datadrivet beslutsfattande inom Företagsmarknad. Du utvecklar moderna rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI och gör data tillgänglig på ett sätt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare och specialister i verksamheten och omvandlar komplexa affärsfrågeställningar till värdeskapande rapporter, dashboards och dataleveranser som används i det dagliga beslutsfattandet.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team av analytiker och data scientists som delar kunskap, utmanar varandra konstruktivt och samarbetar tvärfunktionellt med många delar av organisationen. Teamet har ett övergripande ansvar för Företagsmarknads rapportering och analys. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter och dashboards end-to-end, exempelvis inom försäljning och portföljutveckling. Teamet supporterar också organisationen med data och analys.

Exempel På Ansvarsområden


Identifiera möjligheter att öka användningen av data och BI i verksamheten samt driva förbättringsinitiativ
Omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara analysprodukter, KPI:er och dashboards
Utveckla och vidareutveckla rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI end-to-end
Bygga och förbättra dataflöden samt ETL-processer med moderna tekniker och verktyg
Säkerställa hög användarvänlighet och rätt design i våra rapporter och dashboards
Utveckla ett nära samarbete med stakeholders för att förstå organisationens behov
Ta ägarskap och aktivt bidra i planering av både kort- och långsiktig utveckling
Agera rådgivare till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till analys, rapportering och datadrivet beslutsfattande
Planera och genomföra demo av nya rapporter


Placeringsort är Stockholm och du rapporterar till Chef för Data, Analys & Rapportering.

Om dig | Senior analytiker som skapar insikter och förändring

Det här är en roll för dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av analys och BI, trivs med stort eget ansvar och vill utveckla lösningar som påverkar både affären, kundvärdet och hur organisationen arbetar med data.

För att kvalificera dig för rollen har du:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis Statistik, Matematik, Datavetenskap, Industriell ekonomi eller annat närliggande område
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom dataanalys/BI i affärsnära roll
Mycket goda kunskaper i Power BI, från datamodellering till dashboard-design
Mycket goda kunskaper i statistisk analys och metoder
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av Python, dbt, samt Azure, Databricks eller andra moderna data- och analysplattformar är meriterande
Erfarenhet av att omvandla affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som skapar konkret affärsnytta
Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift


Vi söker dig som har hög kapacitet, stark analytisk förmåga och vilja att bidra till ett team där ansvar, lärande och gemensam utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen.

För att lyckas i rollen kombinerar du stark analytisk och teknisk kompetens med ett stort intresse för kund- och affärsnära frågor. Du uppskattar att själv arbeta hands-on med data, analys och visualisering samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken, förstå verksamhetens behov och bidra till att sätta riktning och prioriteringar.

Om oss | Skapa värde med data i stark gemenskap

Trygg-Hansa är en av Sveriges mest välkända försäkringsaktörer och en del av Tryg-koncernen, en av Nordens största försäkringsgrupper. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där data, analys och kundinsikter spelar en allt viktigare roll för hur vi utvecklar affären och skapar värde för våra kunder. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, ansvarstagande och att skapa utveckling tillsammans, och vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när olika kompetenser och perspektiv får bidra – vi vet att olika erfarenheter och arbetssätt stärker vår förmåga att fatta bättre beslut. Därför arbetar vi aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där fler kan komma till sin rätt och göra ett hållbart och meningsfullt arbete.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss, möta några av dina framtida kollegor och ta del av mer information om våra medarbetarförmåner.

Ansökan | Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan. Då urvalet sker löpande ser vi gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan snarast möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-30.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Frank Svensson på via mail: frank.svensson@trygghansa.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Slutkandidaten kommer att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss kontakt från rekryteringsföretag angående våra annonserade roller.

Nous sommes le premier industriel de la donnée en Europe. Notre métier est de créer, manager et exploiter le patrimoine data de nos clients.

Nous avons la conviction que chaque entreprise peut adopter une démarche innovante de gestion de la donnée et créer des cas d’usage disruptifs en réduisant l'impact écologique et en diminuant la dette technique.

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst confirmé(e) capable d'accompagner les métiers dans l'aide à la décision.

Guider et accompagner les équipes métier dans l’exploitation et la valorisation de leurs données, identifier des leviers d’optimisation et proposer des améliorations des processus business
Servir d’intermédiaire entre le métier et la DSI pour faciliter la circulation de l’information et la mise en place des solutions data
Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers (Marketing, Retail, CRM, Supply, Finance…) et concevoir des dashboards Power BI à forte valeur ajoutée
Modéliser, préparer et fiabiliser les données (SQL, DAX, Databricks, Snowflake) et optimiser les flux pour garantir leur qualité et leur disponibilité
Mener et piloter des études analytiques, conduire des analyses permettant d’éclairer la prise de décision et d’orienter les actions métier

Maîtrise avancée de Power BI
Maîtrise avancée du requêtage SQL
Expertise des outils BI et forte compréhension des données métier
Préparation, transformation et mise en qualité des données sur Snowflake et/ou Databricks
Bonnes compétences en communication et excellente compréhension des enjeux business
Sens du détail, curiosité et forte appétence pour la donnée et l’expérience utilisateur UX/UI, design thinking
Maîtrise de l’anglais obligatoire


Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université, vous justifiez de 4 années d'expérience professionnelle en tant que Data Analyst sur Power BI.

Rigoureux, proactif et autonome vous restez en veille technologique et êtes force de proposition. Vous êtes capable de prendre de la hauteur et vous adapter aux enjeux du projet.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
HTML:
Cerved è la tech company italiana che, grazie a segnali predittivi unici e a un patrimonio esclusivo di dati e analytics, supporta la crescita sostenibile, la gestione del rischio e la trasformazione digitale di imprese e istituzioni.

Con Cerved Rating Agency, elaboriamo valutazioni sul merito di credito, rating ESG e analisi sulle emissioni di debito.

Dal 2021 Cerved è parte di ION Group, uno dei più grandi operatori FinTech internazionali.

Per rafforzare il team Data Models Tools & Processes, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Senior Data Analyst che contribuirà attivamente nell'analisi di dati complessi a supporto delle decisioni di business, trasformando grandi volumi di dati in insight actionable e contribuendo attivamente a progetti di analisi end-to-end.

Principali responsabilità

  • Condurre analisi esplorative (EDA) e analisi avanzate su dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni, utilizzando Python e SQL, per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di business;
  • Progettare e sviluppare dashboard, report interattivi e visualizzazioni dati con strumenti di BI a supporto dei decision maker aziendali;
  • Gestire end-to-end un progetto analitico dalla raccolta e comprensione dei requisiti, alla pulizia e trasformazione dei dati, fino alla produzione e alla comunicazione degli output;
  • Estrarre, combinare e trasformare dati provenienti da sorgenti eterogenee per costruire dataset analitici robusti e riutilizzabili;
  • Sviluppare e mantenere modelli di dati analitici su Databricks garantendo performance, qualità e documentazione;
  • Definire e monitorare KPI e metriche di business, collaborando con i team di Product, Marketing, Finance e Operations per allineare le analisi agli obiettivi strategici;
  • Applicare tecniche di analisi statistica per rispondere a domande di business complesse;
  • Collaborare con i team di Data Engineering e con i team di Data Science;
  • Contribuire alla cultura del dato in azienda.

Requisiti

  • Laurea in Statistica, Matematica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia o discipline affini. Certificazioni Databricks o AWS (Data Analytics) sono apprezzate;
  • Esperienza di almeno 3–5 anni in ruoli di analisi dati, con comprovata partecipazione a progetti di analisi complessi in contesti strutturati (es. finanza, retail, telco, FinTech, insurance);
  • Solide competenze di SQL avanzato (window functions, CTE, subquery complesse, ottimizzazione delle query) su database relazionali e analitici (PostgreSQL, Redshift, Athena, Databricks SQL);
  • Buona padronanza di Python per l’analisi dei dati pandas, NumPy, matplotlib/seaborn, plotly; la conoscenza di PySpark su Databricks costituisce un plus significativo;
  • Esperienza nell’utilizzo della piattaforma Databricks (notebook, Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) per l’esplorazione e l’analisi di dataset di grandi dimensioni;
  • Competenze con almeno uno strumento di BI e data visualization (Power BI, Tableau, Looker o equivalenti) per la creazione di dashboard e report a uso business;
  • Conoscenza dei principali servizi AWS per i dati (S3, Athena, Redshift, Glue) e capacità di interrogare e navigare autonomamente un Data Lake o Data Warehouse cloud;
  • Solida preparazione in statistica applicata distribuzioni, test di ipotesi, regressione, correlazione, analisi della varianza; esperienza con tecniche di segmentazione e forecasting;
  • Ottime capacità di comunicazione e storytelling con i dati;
  • Familiarità con tecniche di base di Machine Learning e AI applicati all’analisi (classificazione, clustering, anomaly detection) e con strumenti come MLflow o Databricks AutoML costituisce un vantaggio.

Sede di lavoro Milano, Mangone (CS), Padova, Torino

Modalità di lavoro Ibrida

La posizione è inquadrata tra 2 e 3 Livello, secondo il CCNL Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi (Commercio) e il range retributivo iniziale previsto è compreso tra Euro 40.000 ed Euro 55.000. L'esatta attribuzione all'interno della fascia retributiva sarà determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi, trasparenti e neutrali sotto il profilo del genere (nel rispetto della normativa vigente).

Cerved Group garantisce (ai sensi del D.Lgs 198/2006, D.Lgs.215/2003 e D.Lgs.216/2003) pari opportunità di accesso al lavoro a tutt* i/le candidat* e si impegna a favorire il rispetto delle diversità e l’inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Don’t settle for just any consulting company, choose the one that’s right for you!




At Data Wizards, we value perseverance, curiosity, creativity, integrity and excellence. In that sense, we are looking for passionate AI & data professionals who want to help companies navigate the transition the world is facing today, and who want to be part of the Wizard adventure we are building.

On our side, we do our best to find exciting, challenging and meaningful projects for you. Today, we work with companies of all sizes, across various sectors, where we believe our work brings real value and purpose.

We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. So this job description is for anyone in data out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




Job description




We’re on the lookout for Data Analysts to join our team of Wizards!




As a Data Analyst, your project would typically include:




Collecting, cleaning, and transforming data from various sources to ensure quality and usability
Writing and optimizing SQL queries and/or using Python to analyze and process data
Building and maintaining dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI) to support business decision-making
Translating business needs into data requirements and actionable insights
Performing exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
Collaborating with data engineers and other teams to ensure data availability and reliability
Contributing to the improvement of data models, datasets, and reporting processes
Ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and documentation of your work
Supporting stakeholders by explaining insights in a clear and structured way




Job requirements




You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background:




Masters degree related to computer science, data or AI
1-4 years of experience in a data role
Previous experience building or maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
Exposure to working with large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., CRM, web analytics, call logs, transactional systems).




Technical Skills:




Solid hands-on experience with Python, and SQL.
Experience with SAS is a plus.
Experience with Databricks is a plus.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and best practices.
Experience integrating reporting tools such as Power BI.
Basic understanding of version control (e.g., Git) and automated workflows/scheduling.




Soft Skills:




Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Good communication skills and attention to detail.
Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-moving environment.




Practical Info:




Languages: Native in French or Dutch and fluent in English




We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.




Here’s a sneak peek at what we offer:




💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated




Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with a fuel card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🎯 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive




Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces with a 24/7 open gym fully equipped
A Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles 🎮
A massage chair for those deep-thinking moments 🧘
Fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕




✨ And most importantly, a growing company where opportunities are limitless!




Our Recruitment Process:

Quick intro call with our HR team
HR Interview
Technical Interview
Partner Meet-up
Potential Interview with a client




About us




At Data Wizards, we value perseverance, curiosity, creativity, integrity and excellence. In that sense, we are looking for passionate AI & data professionals who want to help companies navigate the transition the world is facing today, and who want to be part of the Wizard adventure we are building.

On our side, we do our best to find exciting, challenging and meaningful projects for you. Today, we work with companies of all sizes, across various sectors, where we believe our work brings real value and purpose.




If you’re passionate about what we do but aren’t sure you meet every single requirement—don’t hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.




Let’s build the future of AI & Data, together🤝

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Title: Analyste de données
Description:
Vous cherchez une entreprise qui combine performance technique, impact sociétal et développement personnel ?




Chez Hara Consulting, première ESN mécène co-construite avec des associations locales, nous croyons qu’il est possible de conjuguer carrière IT et engagement solidaire.




Depuis 2021, nous sommes reconnus entreprise à mission, acteur engagé de l’Économie Sociale et Solidaire. Depuis 2023, nous sommes également signataires de la Charte de la Diversité. Chez HARA, nous valorisons les différences et accueillons des personnes de tous les horizons.




En rejoignant Hara, vous mettrez vos compétences au service de projets IT à forte valeur ajoutée tout en soutenant des causes qui vous tiennent à cœur grâce à :

5 jours de mécénat de compétences par an sur votre temps de travail
Un financement solidaire pour accompagner des initiatives locales porteuses de sens
Une implication directe dans notre gouvernance participative




Au sein de notre entreprise, votre impact dépasse votre mission client : vous contribuez à construire l’entreprise engagée de demain




En tant que Data Analyst, vous serez le moteur de la refonte complète d’e notre d’un écosystème décisionnel pour l’un de nos clients. Votre mission consistera à reconstruire « from scratch » un data lake fiable et à industrialiser le reporting Sales & Finance dans un contexte international dynamique entre la France et les équipes à l’étranger, en lien avec les équipes de Data Engineering.




Vos principales missions principales :

Piloter la republication des rapports : assurer la migration et l’optimisation de plus de 30 rapports existants vers la nouvelle infrastructure d’ici fin mars.
Concevoir des dashboards à forte valeur ajoutée : créer et standardiser de nouveaux rapports orientés Sales & Finance pour faciliter le pilotage stratégique.
Garantir la fiabilité de la donnée : participer à la structuration et à l’enrichissement du nouveau data lake pour pallier les manques de l’ancienne infrastructure.
Collaborer en environnement multiculturel : interagir quotidiennement en anglais avec les équipes basées à l’étranger et en France pour assurer la cohérence des livrables.
Documenter avec exigence : rédiger une documentation technique et fonctionnelle irréprochable pour garantir la maintenabilité des solutions déployées.




Vos compétences pour le poste :

Stack Technique : Power BI (maîtrise experte), Microsoft Fabric (à venir), environnement Azure / Databricks.
Équipe : équipe internationale de 6 experts (3 en France, 3 en Malaisie), encadrée par un Lead Data.




Les qualités du/de la candidat(e) que nous recherchons :

Expérience : 4 à 5 ans d’expérience significative en Data Analyse, avec une spécialisation forte sur Power BI.
Formation : diplôme de niveau Bac+5 recommandé (Ingénieur ou Master spécialisé).
Langues : un excellent niveau d’anglais est impératif pour les échanges quotidiens à l’étranger.
Soft Skills : autonomie totale, force de proposition et professionnalisme. Une forte appétence pour les innovations liées à l’IA sera un atout majeur.
Engagement : sensibilité aux projets solidaires et à l’éthique de la donnée.




Les p’tits plus :

Tickets restaurant pris en charge à 60% par l’entreprise
Prise en charge de votre abonnement de transport à 100%
Forfait mobilité verte jusqu’à 800€/an
Plan d’Epargne Entreprise
Accès au CE de Hara
Participation à des activités solidaires à travers du mécénat de compétences.

Title: Data-analist
HTML:
Data Analyst AI


Ben jij een analytische Data Analyst die graag data vertaalt naar inzichten die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden? Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data, business en technologie binnen een internationale organisatie?


Voor een internationale organisatie in Den Bosch zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Analyst.


Over de functie

Als Data Analyst werk je van businessvraag tot bruikbaar inzicht. Je verzamelt, analyseert, transformeert en modelleert data uit verschillende bronnen en vertaalt deze naar dashboards, rapportages en concrete aanbevelingen.


Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders en data-specialisten. Hierdoor ben je niet alleen technisch bezig met data, maar denk je ook actief mee over hoe data de organisatie kan helpen betere beslissingen te nemen.


Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Vertalen van businessvragen naar data-analyses;
  • Verzamelen, transformeren en modelleren van data;
  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages;
  • Werken met SQL en BI-tools;
  • Analyseren van datasets en vertalen van uitkomsten naar inzichten;
  • Samenwerken met verschillende business stakeholders;
  • Bewaken van datakwaliteit;
  • Bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van data en analytics;
  • Ondersteunen van teams bij datagedreven besluitvorming.


Jouw kwaliteiten

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Circa 2-4 jaar ervaring binnen data-analyse of BI;
  • Goede kennis van SQL;
  • Ervaring met Power BI;
  • Ervaring met Snowflake en/of dbt is een pré;
  • Python-kennis is mooi meegenomen;
  • Analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig;
  • Je kunt technische inzichten goed vertalen naar de business;
  • Nieuwsgierig en leergierig.


Over de organisatie

Je komt terecht bij een internationale organisatie binnen de educatieve sector. Vanuit verschillende Europese landen wordt gewerkt aan digitale en fysieke oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt binnen het onderwijs.

Binnen het data- en analyticsdomein wordt volop gewerkt aan het verder datagedreven maken van de organisatie. Je werkt samen met verschillende data-specialisten en stakeholders en krijgt de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan deze ontwikkeling.


Wat bieden ze je

  • Een uitdagende Data Analyst-rol binnen een organisatie met een organisatie met maatschappelijk belang;
  • Een salaris tot circa €70.000 per jaar op basis van 36 uur;
  • Hybride werken is mogelijk, met flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken;
  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling;
  • Een functie waarin je direct impact maakt met data.


Interesse?

Ben jij klaar voor een volgende stap als Data Analyst en wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data en business? Neem dan contact met ons op en stuur je CV mee.
