Data Analyst AI


Ben jij een analytische Data Analyst die graag data vertaalt naar inzichten die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden? Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data, business en technologie binnen een internationale organisatie?


Voor een internationale organisatie in Den Bosch zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Analyst.


Over de functie

Als Data Analyst werk je van businessvraag tot bruikbaar inzicht. Je verzamelt, analyseert, transformeert en modelleert data uit verschillende bronnen en vertaalt deze naar dashboards, rapportages en concrete aanbevelingen.


Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders en data-specialisten. Hierdoor ben je niet alleen technisch bezig met data, maar denk je ook actief mee over hoe data de organisatie kan helpen betere beslissingen te nemen.


Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Vertalen van businessvragen naar data-analyses;
  • Verzamelen, transformeren en modelleren van data;
  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages;
  • Werken met SQL en BI-tools;
  • Analyseren van datasets en vertalen van uitkomsten naar inzichten;
  • Samenwerken met verschillende business stakeholders;
  • Bewaken van datakwaliteit;
  • Bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van data en analytics;
  • Ondersteunen van teams bij datagedreven besluitvorming.


Jouw kwaliteiten

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Circa 2-4 jaar ervaring binnen data-analyse of BI;
  • Goede kennis van SQL;
  • Ervaring met Power BI;
  • Ervaring met Snowflake en/of dbt is een pré;
  • Python-kennis is mooi meegenomen;
  • Analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig;
  • Je kunt technische inzichten goed vertalen naar de business;
  • Nieuwsgierig en leergierig.


Over de organisatie

Je komt terecht bij een internationale organisatie binnen de educatieve sector. Vanuit verschillende Europese landen wordt gewerkt aan digitale en fysieke oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt binnen het onderwijs.

Binnen het data- en analyticsdomein wordt volop gewerkt aan het verder datagedreven maken van de organisatie. Je werkt samen met verschillende data-specialisten en stakeholders en krijgt de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan deze ontwikkeling.


Wat bieden ze je

  • Een uitdagende Data Analyst-rol binnen een organisatie met een organisatie met maatschappelijk belang;
  • Een salaris tot circa €70.000 per jaar op basis van 36 uur;
  • Hybride werken is mogelijk, met flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken;
  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling;
  • Een functie waarin je direct impact maakt met data.


Interesse?

Ben jij klaar voor een volgende stap als Data Analyst en wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data en business? Neem dan contact met ons op en stuur je CV mee.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

SPAM

Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Potentiam is a fast-growing global offshore solutions provider connecting top talent with leading UK and European businesses. With offices across South Africa, Romania, India, and Brazil, we offer international exposure, real career progression, and the opportunity to work with high-performing global teams.

We combine global opportunity with local support - giving you the chance to grow, make an impact, and build a long-term career in a business that’s scaling fast.

Global clients. Clear progression. Real opportunity.




We are an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.




About Our Client

Our client helps organisations unlock value from their customer base, improve efficiency through AI, and build strong data foundations that support scalable growth. Their teams combine industry expertise with advanced AI and data capabilities to deliver solutions that simplify complexity, accelerate outcomes, and strengthen internal capabilities. They focus on end-to-end transformation, enabling businesses to design, optimise, and scale personalised customer engagement strategies that drive meaningful value for both the business and its customers.




Purpose of Role

As a Data Analyst, you will provide analytical support aligned with business needs, transforming data into meaningful insights that drive decision-making. You will work across multiple business areas, helping stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities and improve outcomes through data-driven analysis.




Roles & Responsibilities

Deliver end-to-end data analysis independently, from understanding the business question through to presenting insights and recommendations.
Translate business requirements into clear analytical questions, datasets, and actionable insights
Build, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards and reports for business and client stakeholders.
Develop clear data visualisations and communicate findings effectively to non-technical audiences.
Automate recurring reporting and analytical processes where appropriate.
Work with large and complex datasets and investigate data discrepancies or anomalies.
Collaborate with data engineers, consultants, product owners, business stakeholders, and clients to understand requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
Provide recommendations based on analysis and explain the potential business impact of findings.
Manage multiple analytical requests and prioritise deliverables according to business needs.
Follow GDPR and responsible data-handling principles when working with sensitive or business-critical information.
Contribute to improving reporting processes, data quality, and analytical methodologies.
Use Python for basic to intermediate data analysis or automation where required.




Skills, Qualfications & Abilities

3–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related field.
SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Good practical experience with Power BI, including dashboards, reports, visualisations and basic data modelling concepts.
Strong data validation and reconciliation skills.
Ability to analyse datasets independently and identify meaningful trends, patterns and anomalies.
Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable insights.
Experience with reporting and process automation.
Intermediate Python skills, particularly for data analysis or automation.
Understanding of ETL/data pipelines and how analytical data is produced, without necessarily requiring hands-on data engineering experience.
Basic understanding of data modelling concepts.
Good understanding of data quality, governance, GDPR and responsible data handling.
Degree in relevant discipline (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or similar) or equivalent practical experience.




Data Privacy Notice

The personal information you provide during the application and recruitment process will be used solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with our data protection policies.

For any questions regarding data processing related to HR activities, please contact Chantal Endemann at careers@potentiam.co.uk.

All data shared with third parties complies with applicable confidentiality and retention requirements.

Title: Telecom Sector | Data Analyst
Description:
At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €1B. We believe in transforming technology to create value for our clients, partners and employees in a world where technology is developed for people. We are proud of the culture we have built together. We are proud of our people at the service of technology. We are proud of our diverse environment. Because we are #TechforPeople. Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries. Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description


Analyze data to identify behaviors, patterns, and trends
Monitor operational data and detect deviations from expected results
Create reports and dashboards to support business decisions
Develop and validate SQL queries, ensuring data completeness and accuracy
Validate that all required columns and data fields are correctly populated
Read and interpret technical/functional specifications
Ensure data and reports are compliant with defined specifications
Identify improvement opportunities in processes based on data analysis



Qualifications


Previous experience as a Data Analyst or similar role
Strong knowledge of SQL (queries, data validation, analysis)
Experience with Power BI (Tabular model is a plus)
Good understanding of data quality and data validation principles
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Attention to detail and focus on quality
Ability to understand specifications and translate them into data checks
Good communication skills and ability to work with different stakeholders



Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

Title: (Senior) Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Berlin
Description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our operational squads. In this role you will be able to become an expert in our business and data analysis systems and environment to allow you to champion data-driven decisions as part of the Data Operations team.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
5+ years of experience in an analytical role
You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Title: Data Analyst Data & AI Senior - F/H - CDI
Description:

Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique.

Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable.

Retrouvez nos engagements RSE ici et nos actions en faveur de la diversité ici

Description du poste

Rejoignez notre communauté Data & Analytics chez Talan !

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst Senior capable de dépasser les simples reportings pour déceler les signaux faibles, expliquer les performances et éclairer les décisions stratégiques de nos clients.

Votre valeur ne se mesure pas uniquement à la qualité de vos dashboards, mais à votre capacité à poser les bonnes questions, à challenger les hypothèses et à transformer des millions de lignes de données en recommandations concrètes et actionnables.

Au sein de notre équipe Data & AI Experience, vous accompagnerez de grands groupes dans leur transformation data en combinant expertise analytique, visualisation, compréhension métier et innovations autour de l'IA générative.

Votre rôle sur nos projets :

Au sein d’équipes projets, vous pourrez être en charge des missions suivantes :


Recueillir, comprendre et challenger les besoins métiers afin d'identifier les enjeux de pilotage, de performance et d'aide à la décision.
Explorer et analyser des données provenant de multiples sources pour identifier des tendances, corrélations, signaux et opportunités d'amélioration.
Définir et construire des indicateurs pertinents (KPIs) en lien avec les objectifs stratégiques et opérationnels de nos clients.
Traduire des données complexes en recommandations claires et actionnables à travers des approches de data storytelling adaptées aux différents publics.
Concevoir des tableaux de bord et rapports interactifs sous des outils de datavisualisation comme Power BI favorisant la compréhension, l'analyse et la prise de décision.
Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la cohérence des données utilisées dans les analyses et les restitutions.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data Engineering pour formaliser les besoins en données, améliorer les modèles analytiques et fiabiliser les usages.
Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et documenter les analyses, métriques et règles de gestion.
Exploiter les capacités de l'IA et de l'IA générative pour accélérer l'exploration des données, l'analyse, la génération d'insights et la production de restitutions à forte valeur ajoutée.
Utiliser les fonctionnalités avancées de Power BI (Copilot, Q&A en langage naturel, Smart Narratives, détection d'anomalies, analyses automatisées) pour enrichir l'expérience décisionnelle.
Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'appropriation des outils, la compréhension des indicateurs et le développement d'une culture data au sein des organisations.


Votre rôle chez Talan


Benchmark de solutions et conseil auprès de nos clients sur les technologies data & analytics à adopter, en lien avec leurs besoins
Réalisation de POC (Proof Of Concept) sur les modern data platforms et les outils de data visualisation
Animer la communauté Data & AI : retours d’expérience, conférences internes, mentoring, formations, veille technologique et partage des bonnes pratiques.


#TalanFrance

Qualifications

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie sur des projets data & analytics à fort enjeu, alliant transformation de données et restitution décisionnelle.

Formation & expérience


Titulaire d’un Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur, université) ou équivalent
Minimum 7 ans d’expérience en data analyse dont une expérience significative combinant data visualisation et proposition d’insights.


Data Visualisation & Analytics


Maîtrise avancée de Power BI : modélisation sémantique, DAX, Power Query, conception de tableaux de bord interactifs et optimisation des performances
Excellente capacité à explorer, analyser et interpréter les données afin d'identifier des tendances, opportunités, risques et leviers de performance
Forte culture de la restitution des analyses et du data storytelling et de l’UX appliqué à la data visualisation, avec la capacité à adapter les messages aux différentes populations (métiers, directions, COMEX)
Maîtrise des techniques d'analyse de données : segmentation, analyse comportementale, analyses de performance, corrélations, détection d'anomalies
Connaissance des fonctionnalités d'IA de Power BI (Copilot, Q&A en langage naturel, Smart Narratives, analyse automatisée) pour enrichir les analyses et accélérer la production d'insights
La connaissance d'autres outils de data visualisation (Tableau, Qlik Sense, Looker Studio) constitue un atout


Data Management & Exploitation de la donnée


Solide maîtrise du SQL pour l'exploration, l'analyse et la préparation des données
Usage des outils de data préparation (DBT, Dataiku, Alteryx)
Bonne compréhension des modèles de données et des architectures analytiques modernes
Sensibilité aux enjeux de qualité, de fiabilité et de gouvernance des données
Capacité à exploiter des sources de données variées et à croiser des informations multiples pour construire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée


IA appliquée à l'analyse de données


Maîtrise des usages de l'IA et de l'IA générative pour accélérer l'exploration des données, la recherche d'insights et la production de livrables analytiques
Capacité à utiliser les assistants IA pour enrichir les analyses, automatiser certaines investigations et améliorer l'expérience décisionnelle
Sensibilité aux notions de traçabilité, qualité, sécurité et gouvernance de la donnée


Cloud & Environnements Data


Expérience des environnements analytiques modernes : Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric ou plateformes équivalentes
Compréhension des principes de stockage, de transformation et d'exposition de la donnée dans les plateformes analytiques modernes
La connaissance du versioning (Git) et des pratiques collaboratives de développement constitue un plus


Méthode & outils


Expérience du travail en mode agile (Scrum, Kanban, SAFE)
Capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques et directions
Maîtrise des outils collaboratifs et de gestion de projet (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams...)
Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel (oral et écrit) – B2 minium


Certifications (un plus)


Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600)
Databricks Data Analyst Associate
Certifications IA appliquées à la data et à la Business Intelligence


Qualités personnelles attendues


Esprit analytique développé et forte capacité de résolution de problèmes
Curiosité intellectuelle et goût pour l'exploration des données
Capacité à formuler des recommandations concrètes à partir des analyses
Excellentes qualités de communication et sens de la pédagogie
Autonomie, esprit d'initiative et force de proposition
Orientation résultats et impact métier
Capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs non techniques
Esprit d'équipe et sens du service client


Votre souhait d’évolution

Si vous avez les compétences requises et souhaitez faire partie d’une équipe à taille humaine en pleine expansion, alliant expertise technique et proximité, vous êtes certainement le/la Data Analyst que nous recherchons !

Quelques références


Client du secteur de l’industrie : Modernisation de la plateforme décisionnelle - cadrage des besoins métier, construction des flux de transformation dbt sur Snowflake, modélisation des data marts, développement et déploiement des tableaux de bord Power BI.
Client du secteur du luxe : Mise en place d’une architecture analytics - industrialisation des pipelines ELT (dbt) sur Databricks, définition des règles de gouvernance et de qualité des données, développement des rapports Power BI et déploiement continu intégré à Git.
Client du secteur du transport : Solution de data visualisation self-service - animation d’ateliers de recueil de besoin, modélisation des données sur BigQuery (GCP), création de flux dbt documentés et testés, maquettage et développement des rapports Power BI.


Informations supplémentaires

AVANTAGES :


Plan de formation pour accompagner votre carrière (formations éditeurs, certifications) grâce à nos partenariats nous accordant une position de partenaire privilégié, et management de proximité par des experts
Locaux modernes en centre-ville
Top 5 du Palmarès Great Place to Work
Télétravail jusqu’à 5 jours selon les missions, prime d’équipement de 100€
Mobilité en France et à l’étranger
Top 1% des entreprises évaluées par Ecovadis dans le domaine social, environnemental et éthique
Tickets restaurant, prime vacances, 50% transport (abonnement transport public), mutuelle
Permanence handicap (consultant dédié aux collaborateurs en situation de handicap et aux proches aidants)
Actionnariat salarié
Prime de cooptations
RTT


L’équipe recrutement s’engage à vous proposer un processus de recrutement rapide et fluide :


Un premier échange de 30 min en visio avec le recruteur pour vous présenter le poste et comprendre votre projet professionnel
2 entretiens métier, dont au moins 1 dans nos locaux, pour entrer dans les détails du poste et rencontrer votre futur manager

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Acasus:




“Impact for citizens.”




Acasus helps governments help people.




We are a consultancy delivering transformational reforms in health and education. We have built a reputation in dynamic, and often challenging, countries and contexts.




Acasus undertakes high-profile projects in an expanding group of countries, including: Pakistan, Chad, the DRC, Mozambique, Somalia, Afghanistan, Ethiopia and Nigeria. From increasing vaccine delivery, to providing greater education access for children, our consultants are helping millions of people access better services.




Apply to join us if you want the opportunity to do the same.




How will you make an impact?




You will use the latest data management technologies to improve health and education services for citizens in a number of low- and middle-income countries, including the DRC, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Mozambique, Somalia, Chad, and others.




Tasks and responsibilities:

Work closely with local Associates to create regular analysis and data visualisations for all project stakeholders, including government officials
Understand general and country-specific project requirements
Deliver dashboards and data processing flows
Develop data processing flows that can be used as standards for multiple projects
Work on multiple projects simultaneously
Educate and support other associates and Data Analysts
Collaborate with other functional areas, such as Operations and Engineering




We are looking for:

2+ years of experience in data analysis
Advanced Tableau data visualisation skills, including dashboard design practices
Advanced analytical skills
Ability to present insights to senior stakeholders and decision makers
Advanced SQL skills
Experience with building and maintaining ETL flows is a plus
Experience with unstructured data (e.g. JSON files) is beneficial
Experience with geographic information system (GIS) analysis
Experience with Python or other programming languages is advantageous
Able to work individually and as part of a team
Excellent communication skills
Proficiency in written and spoken English




What's in it for you?

A competitive compensation package
Private Health Insurance
Cafeteria
Year-end bonus based on company and individual performance
High degrees of responsibility and autonomy
Opportunity to learn and grow in an enthusiastic and supportive environment
See your work have a tangible impact on health and education services every day




Our team is diverse in nationality, gender, race, religion, ethnicity, class, age, education and sexuality. Consequently, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.




Tune into the Acasus Podcast to explore our vital work in Africa and Asia. Here you can learn about the work of our team and listen to stories about the challenges that matter most.

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer

Title: Data Analyst Senior F/H
Description:
Rattaché(e) à la direction Digital & Data d’Ulys, le/la Data Analyst Senior a pour mission de développer une connaissance approfondie des clients et prospects afin de produire des analyses directement actionnables.

Il/elle contribue activement à la création de valeur à partir de la donnée pour :


accélérer le développement du parc clients,
améliorer la performance commerciale,
éclairer les décisions sur les stratégies produit, relationnelle et marketing.



Avec une forte orientation business et client, le/la Data Analyst Senior joue un rôle clé dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des stratégies d’Ulys.

Appétence pour les outils d’IA (notamment IA générative) appliqués à l’analyse de données afin d’accélérer la production d’insights

Missions principales :

Au sein d’une équipe de 5 personnes, vous serez en charge de :

1. Analyse & business impact

Comprendre les enjeux des équipes métiers et traduire leurs besoins en analyses data

Produire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée : segmentation clients, comportements, saisonnalité, performance campagnes

Identifier des leviers de fidélisation et de création de valeur

2. Performance commerciale

Accompagner l’optimisation des actions d’acquisition et de développement du parc

Mesurer l’efficacité des dispositifs commerciaux et recommander des axes d’amélioration

3. Contribution à la stratégie produit

Analyser les usages des solutions Ulys

Alimenter les décisions produit avec des insights data

4. Pilotage & datavisualisation

Concevoir et maintenir des dashboards de pilotage (Power BI)

Structurer des indicateurs de performance fiables et partagés

5. Vision client 360°

Contribuer à l’enrichissement de la connaissance client (nouvelles données, nouveaux indicateurs)

Participer à la formalisation des besoins data avec les équipes produit (spécifications, recette)


Structuration & partage



Documenter les analyses et méthodes

Contribuer à la montée en compétence des équipes.

Profil recherché :


Bac +5 en statistiques, économétrie ou data
Expérience ≥ 5 ans en data analyse dans un environnement marketing / client
Expérience en business par abonnement ou B2B appréciée



Compétences clés

Techniques


Maîtrise avancée de SQL
Bonne pratique de Python ou R
Expérience en outils BI (Power BI, Tableau…)



Data & analyse


Capacité à structurer et challenger les analyses
Rigueur et fiabilité dans la production de résultats



Business & communication


Capacité à traduire la data en recommandations actionnables
Aisance à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs non techniques



Soft skills


Esprit analytique et orienté résultats
Autonomie, proactivité
Bon relationnel et capacité à travailler en transverse
Orientation client forte
Vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au cœur des enjeux data et expérience client
Vous évoluerez au sein d'une équipe engagée et dynamique, dans un environnement favorisant l’autonomie et l’impact
Nous vous offrons des conditions de travail attractives (télétravail, localisation, avantages...).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.




Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.




Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.




Principali responsabilità:

Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.




Competenze e capacità richieste:

Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al "cosa", vuoi capire il "perché".
Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.




Requisiti:

Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.




Cosa offriamo:

Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
Pacchetto welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.




Perché lavorare con noi:

Entrerai in un gruppo che integra consulenza, tecnologia e comunicazione, lavorando su progetti concreti per imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione.
Avrai l’opportunità di confrontarti con competenze diverse e contribuire a iniziative che uniscono strategia, execution e sviluppo del mercato.
Lavorerai in un contesto in evoluzione, dove sperimentazione e collaborazione sono parte integrante del modo di operare.
Utilizziamo l’AI e strumenti avanzati per supportare le attività quotidiane e migliorare l’efficacia del lavoro.
Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente che favorisce autonomia e responsabilità.
Investiamo nella crescita delle persone, attraverso formazione continua e opportunità di sviluppo professionale.




La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a persone con disabilità, di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Compensation And Benefits

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
NWEA® is a division of HMH that supports students and educators through research, assessment solutions, policy and advocacy services, professional learning and school improvement services that fight for equity, drive classroom impact and push for systemic change in our educational communities. For nearly 50 years, NWEA has developed innovative pre-K–12 assessments, including their flagship interim assessment, MAP® Growth™ and their reading fluency and comprehension assessment, MAP® Reading Fluency™. For more information, visit NWEA.org to learn more.

HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities. HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com

Location: Remote (U.S.)

What You’ll Do

Working in the NWEA Learning Sciences division, the Sr Data Analyst will support the Research and Policy Partnerships team by making complex assessment and product data accessible, reliable, and usable for research, reporting, and organizational decision-making. This role will work with large-scale education datasets and build efficient, reproducible processes for extracting, transforming, and preparing data for analysis.

Responsibilities

The Sr Data Analyst will partner closely with researchers and internal stakeholders to understand data needs and translate them into accurate, efficient data solutions. Responsibilities will include:


Use SQL, Python, and/or R to extract, clean, transform, link, and prepare large-scale assessment and product datasets for research and analysis.
Develop and maintain reproducible data workflows and pipelines that improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of recurring data needs.
Conduct data pulls and analyses of HMH product usage data to support Product Efficacy and Validation and other internal stakeholders.
Partner with researchers to translate research questions and analytic specifications into appropriate datasets and data structures.
Design and conduct quality assurance procedures to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Document data sources, definitions, code, and processes so that workflows are transparent, reproducible, and maintainable by others.
Troubleshoot data issues and investigate unexpected patterns or discrepancies in collaboration with researchers and other data experts.
Identify opportunities to automate or streamline recurring data processes and improve how the team accesses and uses data.
Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues about data availability, limitations, definitions, and appropriate use.


Required

What you’ll need:


Experience: 2-5 years of relevant experience (or combined experience and coursework).
Degree: M.S. in statistics, education, psychology, economics, or a related field.
Technical:
Expertise in advanced data manipulations, processing large datasets, and optimization of code.
Proficiency in Python and/or R for data processing, manipulation, automation, and analysis.
Strong SQL skills and demonstrated experience querying and manipulating large, complex datasets.
Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex data problems.
Experience in:
Designing and conducting quality assurance procedures to ensure correct data and accurate results.
Understanding analytic or research requirements and translating them into appropriate data specifications and solutions.
Documenting technical processes clearly and collaborating effectively with researchers and other technical and nontechnical colleagues.

Preferred


Experience working with Snowflake, Postgres, Amazon Redshift, or other cloud-based data warehouse/database systems.
Experience working with large-scale education, assessment, longitudinal, or product usage data.
Familiarity with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Experience working in a collaborative research environment or supporting quantitative researchers.


How We Work (Competencies)


Communicates Effectively: Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
Instills Trust: Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
Optimizes Work Processes: Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
Manages Complexity: Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.


Physical Requirements


Might be in a stationary position for a considerable time (sitting and/or standing)
Constantly operate a computer
Must be able to collaborate with colleagues via face to face, conference calls, and online meetings
Must be capable of sitting, standing, and walking for extended periods of time.


Benefits And Salary Range

Salary Range - $80,000 to $95,000. Our salary ranges are based on national averages. We have wide ranges so we can be flexible and determine compensation based on a number of factors including the candidate’s skills, experience, education, and location.

Our Culture and Benefits - https://careers.hmhco.com/culture_benefits

Application Deadline

August 25, 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The posting may be available past this date but is not guaranteed.

Proven ability to build trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python
Knowledge of data security concepts
Experience supporting higher education administrative functions

Title: Sr BI Analyst
Description:
Description

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst supports the organization’s Voice of Customer (VoC) and customer insights efforts by analyzing data from customer feedback programs, external third-party research and internal customer and operational data. This individual is responsible for the development, implementation and maintenance of data-driven solutions to support strategic decision-making. Additionally, this role involves working closely with various senior CX leaders and business stakeholders to gather requirements, perform data analysis, and create insightful reports and dashboards. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and skilled at synthesizing data into compelling findings, recommendations and actionable customer insights.

Customer Data Analysis

Analyze data from internal VoC programs (e.g., NPS, CSAT, transactional surveys, complaints, etc).

Review and interpret external third-party research (e.g., benchmark studies, market research, syndicated reports).

Identify trends, patterns, and emerging customer needs across channels and touchpoints.

Transform data into easily understandable visualizations and reports to inform decision making and insights.

Insights and Recommendations

Identify necessary data to support hypothesis testing and conduct database queries and supporting analysis.

Develop practical, data-backed recommendations to improve customer experience, processes, or service / product offerings

Synthesize findings into clear summaries that highlight key customer insights, recommendations and implications.

Contribute to dashboards, reports, and recurring insights deliverables for internal stakeholders.

Create clear charts, tables, and visuals that effectively communicate findings.

Ensure data accuracy and consistency across reports.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work with senior CX team members to support presentations for business leaders.

Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests and support ongoing CX initiatives.

Learn and apply best practices in customer research, analytics, and storytelling.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field.

5-7 years of experience in analytics, customer insights, market research, consulting, or a related role.

Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative data and draw meaningful conclusions.

Data Tools: Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets; familiarity with BI or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qualtrics) is a plus.

Data Integration: Ability to extract data from the enterprise data warehouse and perform analysis using SQL and Python.

Synthesis & Storytelling: Strong ability to distill complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail.

Collaboration: Comfortable working with cross-functional partners and supporting senior team members.

Research Fundamentals: Basic understanding of survey design, research methods, and data interpretation.

Curiosity & Learning Mindset: Interest in customer experience, continuous improvement, and learning new tools and methodologies.

Qualifications

Exposure to Voice of Customer programs or customer survey platforms (e.g., Qualtrics, Medallia, etc.).

Experience working with external research vendors or syndicated research (JD Power, Bain, Forrester, etc.).

Basic knowledge of statistics or data visualization best practices.

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Senior Health Data Analyst on the Compass Patient Team for Veeva Compass, you’ll focus on the health data in our Compass Patient data product.

Veeva Compass is our suite of data products, with Compass Patient including prescription and medical claims record-level data to support more broad de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases, like patient journey, market landscape, provider engagement, and more.

You’ll own health data investigations and improvements as part of our Product team. You’ll focus on three key areas:


Data Support - investigate internal and external questions and requests to understand data trends and behavior within customer-defined cohorts and across the network.
Data Quality - Define and track quality metrics in your target domain in dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and work cross-functionally to document and share learnings.
Data Network Improvements - Collaboratively launch new features to continue to enhance our data in your target expertise area. You’ll focus on investigating, defining and testing productizable improvements that work at scale across billions of records.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about data and excited about working alongside Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Engineers, and QA to implement improvements to continue to enrich our data and drive product excellence.

What You’ll Do


Own the investigation and resolution of data observations and data questions driven by internal and external stakeholders
Understand our product pipeline and impact to data to identify improvements
Build standard templates and practices to streamline data quality in your target domains
Own key analytics projects in the data and feature roadmaps
Design new data analytics and data quality features & capabilities, including features such as match, merge, dedupe logic, value enrichment and reference mappings
Establish quality metrics and build dashboards to drive continuous improvement of our data products for key areas such as merging, payer data, lab, prescribers, etc.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing prescription data and medical claims data
Advanced SQL skills; able to query and manipulate relational databases
Knowledge of Industry Standard billing codes such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NDC
Experience documenting and presenting analytics results with stakeholders
Experience defining KPIs and building dashboards to measure success


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in commercial life science use cases
Experience in enterprise products


Interviewing with Veeva

Title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing and Customer Experience
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain-specific marketing and customer experience team's data offerings - including a customer acquisition and retention forecast. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:  

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!  

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location. 

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

Title: Data Visualization Analyst
Description:
Ocean Spray is hiring for a(n) Data Visualization Analyst! We’re a team of farmers, thinkers, creators, and doers. Whatever your title, whatever your role — it always comes back to this: we’re a farmer-owned co-op where everyone rolls up their sleeves to get the job done. Three maverick farmers started it all — and we’ve been making our own way ever since.

Role

The Data Visualization Analyst role is designed to help the commercial teams extract, summarize and visualize relevant past performance metrics to drive future performance. It requires a creative thinker who has the ability to transform ideas into actionable tolls that help teams deliver their objectives. This role will:


Work across multiple business teams learning how they operate, understanding insights they need to make decisions
Analyze information from multiple data sources, external and internal to identify business drivers that affect growth and efficiency
Design reports, tools and tracking mechanisms
Translate ideas into tangible output


A Day in the Life...


Delivering insights using compelling Power BI or SAC visualization techniques for business team.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable reporting and visualization thru rapid prototyping and storytelling.
Building models and designing experiments that seek to uncover insights that drive performance.
Analyzing complex data made of unstructured, semi-structured and structured datasets to drive insights.
Active participant in designing creative new ways to use data to help commercial team drive growth.
Work in an environment with internal IT, business teams and external vendors to design and scale work-flows, templates and dashboards .


What We Are Looking For


BA/BS in computer science or related field or equivalent relevant experience, preferably with a focus on data visualization
Minimum 5 years of related experience
Extensive experience with Data Visualization using tools like PowerBI (preferred) and Tableau
Demonstrate ability to work effectively with others within a complex, cross-functional and fast paced organization
Excellent communication. Ability to present ideas and insights to business stakeholders
CPG industry knowledge


Education

Bachelor's or University Degree (Required)

Work Experience

At least 3 Years of Experience

Annual Salary

$87,400 - $120,230

The base salary range information above serves as a guideline of the position’s typical hiring range. We value and appreciate what makes you unique and will consider a variety of factors when determining an offer. These factors include, but are not limited to, your skills and experience, external and internal benchmarks, as well as overall company considerations. Certain positions may be eligible for short-term and long-term incentive rewards. We also offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being.

Benefits


Complete insurance package on Day-1 that includes a plethora of health and wellness programs
Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Life and accident insurance
Employee assistance program
Telehealth services
1:1 health coaching
Supportive benefits for all the stages of your life
401(k) with up to 6% Company matching; additional potential discretionary match at year-end
Short-Term Incentive/Performance bonuses
Flexible scheduling options
Vacation pay, up to three weeks of time (pro-rated for your first year of employment)
Holiday pay for 12 holidays
Career development and growth opportunities
Tuition/Education assistance programs
Access to LinkedIn Learning
Scholarship programs for children of employees
Parental leave
Bright Horizons Family Solutions – Back-up care, tutoring, etc.
Adoption assistance
Bereavement leave
Up to $300 fitness reimbursement
Up to $300 massage reimbursement
Employee appreciation events
Employee discounts
Charitable giving

Who We Are

You might have our iconic cranberry juice in your fridge or have gotten into heated holiday debate about what’s better - canned or fresh cranberry sauce. But did you know that the hardworking people growing the superfruit in our products are 700 family farmers that own our cooperative? They entrust us with what is most precious to them to create new and innovative products that will delight consumers and grow this beloved brand today and into the future.

Team Members, Farmers, Consumers And Communities Alike--we Value What Makes Us Unique And Strive To Connect Our Farms To Families For a Better Life By Living Our Values


Grower Mindset – We embrace our grower-owners innovative spirit and heritage through confidence, learning and focus on the future.
Sustainable Results – Guided by purpose, we are focused on delivering results for our grower-owners.
Integrity Above All – We are ethical, doing the right thing for our grower-owners, customers, consumers and each other
Inclusive Teamwork – We build diverse and inclusive teams that strengthen our cooperative.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

For MA Applicants – It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. Any employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Title: Analyst, Digital & Loyalty Analytics
Description:
Job Purpose:

The Analyst, Digital & Loyalty Analytics is the hands-on quantitative engine for Panera’s loyalty and customer intelligence team. Sitting within the Business Analytics organization, you will write complex queries, analyze guest transactional data, measure CRM campaign performance, and build automated dashboards that drive decision-making across the MyPanera Loyalty program and digital channels.




This role requires strong technical execution in SQL and visualization tools, combined with a natural curiosity for consumer behavior and digital product performance.




Location: Newton, MA (Hybrid – 3 days per week in-office)




Key Responsibilities:

Data Extraction & SQL Execution: Write clean, efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and aggregate guest, transaction, and campaign data across large-scale enterprise data environments.
CRM & Loyalty Campaign Measurement: Analyze the performance of loyalty offers, email/app messaging, and personalized promotions to measure redemption rates, incremental sales, transaction lift, and margin impact.
Dashboard & Visualization Development: Design, deploy, and maintain high-impact Power BI dashboards tracking key loyalty KPIs, including active member growth, subscription retention (Unlimited Sip Club), and customer lifecycle trends.
A/B Testing & Experimentation Support: Execute readout evaluations for marketing tests and digital feature rollouts, applying statistical methods to measure baseline vs. test performance and incremental lift.
Customer Segmentation & Behavioral Analysis: Perform ad-hoc exploratory analysis to understand guest frequency patterns, lapsed behavior, category affinity, and trade-down risks.
Data Integrity & Validation: Partner with data engineering teams to validate data pipelines, test tracking schemas, and resolve data quality issues across CRM and loyalty databases.




Qualifications:

Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or marketing analytics (Retail, QSR, E-commerce, or agency background preferred).
Technical Skills:
Strong hands-on SQL skills required (joins, window functions, complex aggregations).
Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery) and Excel.
Analytical Mindset: Foundational knowledge of digital/loyalty metrics (e.g., offer redemption, customer retention, A/B test lift, conversion rates).
Communication: Ability to summarize analytical findings clearly in slide format and discuss results with cross-functional partners.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related quantitative field.




Competitive Pay: $83,686 - $95,402 annually




The actual pay offered will be determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, job-related knowledge, skills, and geographical location. Individual compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.




Equal Opportunity Employer: Disabled/Veterans

Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!



Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.



What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!



Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.



Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.



With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.







Job Description



The Opportunity



We, at Flywire, are looking for a smart, analytical thinker who's excited to wow our clients with best in class data and analytics capabilities. As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will help set the vision and direction for how we communicate the story of Flywire's data to our clients, both with interactive in-app reporting solutions and custom analytics projects that speak to the unique value and ROI that our product has delivered throughout our partnership.



This is a true cross-functional role, with responsibilities crossing data & analytics, product development, relationship management, and sales. The ideal candidate will feel comfortable managing cross-functional projects and also have a deep technical understanding of a general BI stack and will be able to periodically contribute to development and analysis.



The responsibilities of the role include:



Help set a broad company vision for the way we communicate data and our value proposition to clients
Partner with business stakeholders to understand unique client situations and deliver analyses to show the value of Flywire's value and performance
Lead the design and development of customer-facing dashboards
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure that reporting and analytical solutions are secure, scalable, and part of a seamless user experience


Qualifications



Here's What We're Looking For



5-7 years of experience in business intelligence, product management, data and analytics, or a related field
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams
Strong experience with business intelligence tools is required, with a preference for Looker and Sigma
Comfortable presenting to both internal and external stakeholders
Strong communication skills: You can make even the most complex data easy to comprehend
Emerging data science and analytical skills

Experience working with client or CRM data (e.g. Salesforce) to build a unified view of client relationships and usage patterns

Description:
Position Summary

Analyze large amounts of data, supplying statistical information, interpreting data, managing data and providing technical support to help the department allocate resources, measure performance, and help design new programs, facilities and systems. Typically involves Quality Assurance/Improvement, Database Management, and streamlining data collection processes. May oversee and coordinate research projects as well as statistical tests and programs.

Position: Pediatrics Data Analyst

Department: Pediatrics

Schedule: Full Time

Performs a variety of duties related to data management, and analysis including: SAS programming, dataset cleaning, descriptive analyses, regression modeling, power calculations, creation of SPC comparative reports in QI on a regular basis
Assists with data presentations needed in abstracts, manuscript preparation and presentations.
