Provides data and information to network partners in a readily accessible, understandable and actionable manner using tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and other tools as needed.
Conducts literature searches using web-based search engines and other reference tools and synthesizes information in requested formats.
Assists in the dissemination of project and specific study-related information through conferences and presentations and contributes to the methods and results sections of manuscripts for peer review.
Collaborates across the department to support financial initiatives, including outpatient, inpatient, and Emergency Department (ED) data analytics.
Performs other duties as assigned and/or necessary.


Education

JOB REQUIREMENTS


Bachelor's Degree required, plus three years of experience with data collection, analysis, and/or program evaluation; or
Master's Degree in a healthcare field plus one year of relevant experience.
Advanced statistical courses (2) can be substituted for one year of relevant experience


Knowledge And Skills

Title: Senior Sales Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

CarGurus is hiring a Senior Sales Data Analyst to support our Inventory & Data pillar as we build, sell, and scale the next generation of dealer software.

You'll serve as a core analytical partner for a high-growth pillar, translating disparate signals from Salesforce, Gong, and internal product telemetry into the data foundations our go-to-market organization needs to scale. Your work will bridge the gap between complex raw data and the repeatable, high-impact reporting that drives execution across the full dealer journey with our products.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to build the data foundations behind a new team-selling motion and a growing software portfolio. It's ideal for someone who enjoys building in ambiguity, shaping new processes, and helping a business scale with the right metrics from the start.

The ideal candidate is an advanced SQL practitioner who is equally comfortable partnering with Engineering on CRM and reporting design as they are coaching stakeholders on how to interpret and act on data. They're energized by being early to a new business and building from the ground up.

What You'll Do

Build the pillar's GTM analytics foundation


Own pipeline, install base, and churn reporting for the pillar's products, turning early prototypes into scalable, repeatable views.
Build demo-to-close analytics: demo volume, no-shows, source attribution, and downstream MRR impact. Surface insights from Gong customer conversations.
Lead analytics for new product launches, tracking adoption, attach, and retention from beta through GA.
Partner with Product Analytics to define KPIs and integrate product telemetry into go-to-market analysis.


Challenge process and close system gaps


Pinpoint where our processes and Salesforce design don't line up, the gaps that make the new team-selling motion hard to track, attribute, and measure.
Don't take existing processes at face value: question the status quo, design better approaches, and drive solutions that make the business measurable by default.
Partner with Operations, Engineering, and Sales to streamline workflows and evolve CRM design for better tracking of pipeline, team selling, and clean revenue attribution.
Define and enforce data governance for key workflows (demos, onboarding, no-shows, opportunity tagging, quoting) so downstream reporting is trusted.


Drive prospecting and post-sale insight


Build prospecting signals that surface high-potential dealers for each product, and partner with sales tool owners to wire them into the platforms reps use every day.
Manage capacity and supply-demand reporting for products like Sell My Car so teams prioritize the right markets.
Partner with Customer Success on dealer-level engagement tracking, surfacing adoption-risk and churn signals so account and product teams can intervene early.


Set the technical standard


Write production-grade SQL on Snowflake and partner with Analytics Engineering to productionize durable data assets in dbt.
Build and maintain dashboards across our BI and CRM analytics tools (Looker, Omni, Salesforce CRM Analytics) so insights live where leaders and reps work.
Keep Inventory analytics aligned with broader Sales Analytics standards and definitions across CarGurus.


What You'll Bring


5+ years in analytics, sales analytics, business intelligence, or data strategy, ideally in SaaS, technology, or consulting.
Bachelor's degree in business, finance, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake strongly preferred).
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including its core data structures and how they support or limit selling motions. Experience with Gong data is a plus.
Experience with modern analytics tooling such as dbt, Looker, Omni, and Salesforce CRM Analytics.
Solid grasp of SaaS and recurring-revenue metrics: pipeline, attach, conversion, churn, retention, and MRR.
A proven ability to turn ambiguous questions into clear analyses and durable reporting with the judgment to build structure where processes and metrics are still taking shape.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders.
Comfort in a cross-functional, matrixed, fast-moving environment.
Bonus: interest or experience in the automotive marketplace, dealer software, inventory management, pricing, or sourcing products.


Why this role

You'll help shape how CarGurus brings a growing portfolio of software and data products to market, building the measurement and reporting infrastructure a new business needs to scale. You'll partner closely with leaders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations, influencing strategy while creating the systems, metrics, and insights that guide key business decisions. If you enjoy building in ambiguity, driving meaningful change, and helping a business scale from the ground up, you'll thrive in this role.

The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$87,000—$109,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Position Summary

The Lead Data Analyst (Network) is at the forefront of data-driven initiatives for the group, acting as a linchpin between raw data and actionable insights. This position dissects complex datasets, identifies  patterns, and leverages those insights to drive business growth. Collaborates closely with various internal and external stakeholders, helping them understand the data and how this information can shape future strategies.

Responsibilities:

Advanced Analytics: Develop and deploy advanced analytical models to improve our understanding of Network supply and demand, identify operational inefficiencies, and deliver actionable recommendations to leadership
Performance Monitoring: Implement real-time dashboards and reporting to track and assess Network performance against established metrics
Network Strategy Innovation: Challenge the status quo and be willing to propose and test new strategies for increasing competition and engagement within our service provider network
Stakeholder Feedback Analysis: Analyze feedback, ratings, and reviews from multiple sources and stakeholders to gain insights into service quality, customer satisfaction, and provider satisfaction, identifying actionable insights for improvement
Service Provider Insights: Develop operational and performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations for 3rd party service providers, enabling them to enhance their service delivery, optimize processes, and align more closely with organizational objectives
Capacity Analysis and Modeling: Analyze the capacity of our Network, identifying gaps, weaknesses, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality, making recommendations for Network recruiting, retention, and optimization
Testing: Leads test and pilots for process changes as a a result of analysis and communicates the results and recommendations to all areas of management
Subject matter expert: Serves as an internal data analytics expert by ensuring consistency in data analysis methodologies and sharing of best practices

Experience and Skills:

BA/BS Degree or equivalent experience. Degree that emphasizes data analysis and communication (e.g., computer science, social sciences, physical sciences, math, engineering, or statistics) preferred
5+ years of business and data analysis experience
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Strong problem-solving skills and business acumen
Experience with data management, specifically with validating and auditing data and reports from multiple systems
Demonstrated project and task management capability
Past experience with BI, Google Workspace, and CRM Tools
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases is required
An analytical professional with attention to detail and high standard of performance excellence

Hiring In:

United States: Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, New York State, New Mexico, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia

Job Title Enterprise Marketing Data Analyst – Cross-Functional Insights & Visualization

Locations: Boston, MA, New York, NY | Hybrid

About The Role

Join SS&C’s Corporate Marketing team and help shape a globally recognized brand powered by data-driven insight. This role plays a critical part in defining how marketing performance is measured, understood, and communicated across integrated campaigns, digital channels, and corporate initiatives worldwide. You will transform complex datasets into clear, compelling insights that guide strategy, optimize investment, and elevate executive decision-making. If you’re passionate about blending analytics, storytelling, and brand impact to drive growth in a global financial technology leader, this role offers the opportunity to make a visible, lasting impact.

Why Join SS&C

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

How You Will Make An Impact

Cross-Functional Data Partnership


Engage with business units to understand their data needs, processes, and KPIs.
Map and document the data landscape across systems (CRM, MAP, web analytics, advertising platforms, product data, etc.).
Serve as the primary analytics liaison, ensuring marketing has accurate, accessible, and trusted data to support decision-making.
Translate business challenges into clear analytical requirements and data solutions.


Analytics, Insights & Storytelling


Analyze marketing performance across channels, segments, and lifecycle stages to identify trends, gaps, and growth opportunities.
Transform complex datasets into concise insights that marketing leaders can act on.
Develop insights frameworks that support campaign optimization, ROI analysis, attribution, funnel performance, and forecasting.
Present findings with clarity, business context, and recommendations.


Data Visualization & Dashboard Development


Design and build intuitive, executive-ready dashboards using platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
Automate reporting to eliminate manual processes and improve data accuracy and speed.
Ensure dashboards emphasize clarity, trust, and storytelling—not just data display.
Maintain and evolve a library of standardized metrics, definitions, and reporting models.


Data Quality, Governance & Process Improvement


Identify and resolve data quality issues across systems; partner with RevOps, IT, and Data Engineering on remediation.
Contribute to governance frameworks, ensuring consistent KPI definitions across the organization.
Recommend improvements to data pipelines, integrations, and enrichment processes.


Required Experience


3–7+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Marketing Operations, Business Intelligence, or Data Analysis.
Strong data visualization skills with hands-on experience in BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Domo, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL and structured data manipulation.
Experience with CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation tools (Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua), and digital analytics platforms (GA4, Adobe Analytics).
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Strong communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.


What Sets You Apart (preferred Qualifications)


Experience in B2B SaaS, financial services, technology, or other data-driven environments.
Familiarity with attribution models, pipeline analysis, and forecasting.
Experience with AWS, Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or similar tools.
Background in statistics, predictive modeling, or experimentation.

Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
Limited travel may be required.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Network)
Description:
About Agero:Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way. Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Position Summary

The Lead Data Analyst (Network) is at the forefront of data-driven initiatives for the group, acting as a linchpin between raw data and actionable insights. This position dissects complex datasets, identifies  patterns, and leverages those insights to drive business growth. Collaborates closely with various internal and external stakeholders, helping them understand the data and how this information can shape future strategies.

Responsibilities:

Advanced Analytics: Develop and deploy advanced analytical models to improve our understanding of Network supply and demand, identify operational inefficiencies, and deliver actionable recommendations to leadership
Performance Monitoring: Implement real-time dashboards and reporting to track and assess Network performance against established metrics
Network Strategy Innovation: Challenge the status quo and be willing to propose and test new strategies for increasing competition and engagement within our service provider network
Stakeholder Feedback Analysis: Analyze feedback, ratings, and reviews from multiple sources and stakeholders to gain insights into service quality, customer satisfaction, and provider satisfaction, identifying actionable insights for improvement
Service Provider Insights: Develop operational and performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations for 3rd party service providers, enabling them to enhance their service delivery, optimize processes, and align more closely with organizational objectives
Capacity Analysis and Modeling: Analyze the capacity of our Network, identifying gaps, weaknesses, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality, making recommendations for Network recruiting, retention, and optimization
Testing: Leads test and pilots for process changes as a a result of analysis and communicates the results and recommendations to all areas of management
Subject matter expert: Serves as an internal data analytics expert by ensuring consistency in data analysis methodologies and sharing of best practices

Experience and Skills:

BA/BS Degree or equivalent experience. Degree that emphasizes data analysis and communication (e.g., computer science, social sciences, physical sciences, math, engineering, or statistics) preferred
5+ years of business and data analysis experience
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Strong problem-solving skills and business acumen
Experience with data management, specifically with validating and auditing data and reports from multiple systems
Demonstrated project and task management capability
Past experience with BI, Google Workspace, and CRM Tools
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases is required
An analytical professional with attention to detail and high standard of performance excellence

Hiring In:

United States: Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, New York State, New Mexico, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia

The anticipated closing date to submit applications for this role is June 20th, 2026. Join our Greenhouse Candidate Portal to track your application status and receive instant alerts for future openings.

The base salary range presented represents the anticipated low and high end salary range for new hires in this position. Your final base salary will be determined based on factors such as work location, experience, job related skills, and relevant training and education. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package provided by Agero to employees.

National Pay Range: $110,000 USD - $135,000 USD

Life at Agero:

At Agero, you'll find a workplace where your unique perspective is not just welcomed, it's celebrated. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we're committed to creating an environment where every employee feels a sense of belonging. If you're looking for a company that values your individuality, provides opportunities for growth, and champions open communication, Agero is the place for you. Join our team and help us drive the future of driver assistance, while experiencing a workplace where you can truly thrive.

Benefits Built for Well-being: 

Agero’s innovation is driven by a workforce where all associates feel like they can truly thrive. Agero offers a wide range of benefits to promote well-being, encourage personal development, and ensure financial stability. Our benefits include:

Health and Wellness: Healthcare, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and mental health benefits for associates and their families.
Financial Security: 401(k) plan with company match and tuition assistance to support your future goals.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible time off, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually.
For Contact Center Roles: Accrual of up to 3 weeks Paid Time Off per year, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually.

Bonus/Incentive Programs

Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Our Brand

At J.Jill, we’re redefining what it means to dress and live with ease. As a women-led, Boston-based lifestyle brand with 200+ stores nationwide, we design thoughtful, inspired apparel and accessories that celebrate the totality of all women. We’re entering an exciting chapter of growth — expanding our footprint, reaching new customers, and deepening long-standing relationships. We're seeking bold thinkers and doers to join us. With competitive pay and benefits, a supportive culture, and the chance to make a real impact, this is more than a job, it’s an opportunity to bring our ethos keep it simple, make it matter to life in new and inspiring ways.

Overview

The Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams across J.Jill, including Real Estate, Marketing, Retail Operations, and Merchandising, to provide data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. This role performs end-to-end business analysis by translating business questions into actionable recommendations through SQL queries, Excel spreadsheets, and data visualization. The Business Analyst evaluates business performance, analyzes A/B testing results, develops automated reporting solutions using BI tools such as Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI, and presents findings through clear, impactful presentations and reports. Additionally, the role supports real estate strategy by developing sales forecasts for new store locations, closures, and transfers to help drive profitable growth.

Responsibilities


Builds partnerships and operates cross functionally to provide analytical decision support to leaders to increase revenue and profit of various initiatives.
Takes an active role in conception, design, execution, and analysis of corporate-wide testing activities.
Understands key performance indicators that drive company results and determines how these metrics track against overall business strategies, goals and objectives.
Takes initiative acting as a subject matter expert on analytics, quantification, and process automation and provides advanced analytics to support longer-range plans and initiatives.
Provides recommendations for improvements to tools, scorecards, KPIs & benchmarks.
Performs end-to-end business analytics: 1) Understands business question 2) Structures Excel spreadsheet 3) Builds accurate SQL queries (validating results) 4) Summarizes analytical insights and business recommendations into a PowerPoint deck and/or email.
Performs data analysis tasks, evalution of A/B Tests, etc. to develop recommendations that will improve decision making across the organization.
Develops automated self-service business reporting through BI tools including Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI.
Calculates sales estimates for potential new store locations as well as store closure and store transfer estimates for existing stores.


Benefits, Tailored for You.


401(k) retirement plan with discretionary match and tuition reimbursement.
Medical, dental, vision, company paid LTD/STD, and generous amount of paid time off.
Generous associate discount; group discounts on auto, pet and homeowner insurance.
Discount Marketplace for travel, consumer products, food, auto buying, etc.
Associate resource groups.


Qualifications


Advanced SQL skills required; experience with statistical predictive analytics tools like R and Python preferred.
Natural analytical curiosity is essential.
Must demonstrate attention to detail and accuracy, a high degree of organization, and have pride in work.
Desire to continuously learn, ability to learn quickly and confidence to ask questions to gain clarity are required.
Strong aptitude with MS Office tools, especially advanced Excel skills.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Tableau) preferred.
Self-motivated with an ability to both work independently as well as collaboratively across functions and business areas.
Ability to not only retrieve and report data, but to also analyze the implications and make recommendations on various key business questions.
Excellent written and verbal communication/follow-up skills (follow up with project partners to ensure accurate and timely completion of deliverables).
Exposure to retail metrics (sales, inventory, UPT, conversion rates, etc.) preferred.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and consistently meet deadlines.


Education & Experience


3+ years of business experience in an analytical or technical role.
Advanced Excel and SQL skills required.
Statistical analysis and predictive modeling (R, Python) experience preferred.
Reporting and analysis experience in a retail environment preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in business or quantitative discipline (statistics, math) preferred.

Title: Senior Quality Data Analyst
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under the direction of the System Director, Quality and/or System Director, Quality Analytics, the Senior Quality Data Analyst supports quality, safety, patient experience, regulatory, equity and strategic performance analytics across the health system. This role leverages software applications to design advanced reporting and analytic solutions, develops predictive and analytic solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis, and translates complex data into actionable insights for operational, financial and strategic decision-making.

The Senior Quality Data Analyst serves as a primary analytic point of contact and analytics consultant for assigned quality and operational areas and works as a strategic business partner with leaders and teams to produce data that assists in key decision-making, quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and enhanced patient outcomes. The role leads enterprise-level analytic initiatives, coordinates complex cross-functional projects, and provides subject matter expertise in quality measurement, regulatory reporting, and performance analytics. This position requires intellectual curiosity, strong technical and analytic skills, and the ability to manage multiple complex data projects simultaneously.

The Senior Quality Data Analyst utilizes hospital systems, databases, reporting tools, and business intelligence applications to update, analyze, visualize, and disseminate data. This role maintains the integrity and quality of data by understanding workflows, validating source data and metric logic, and translating business needs into technical specifications for reports, dashboards, and analytic products. The position also serves as an enterprise resource for data governance, reporting standards, and performance measurement, while identifying opportunities to enhance analytics through automation, emerging technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Complex Data Projects & Stakeholder Partnership


Manages multiple complex data projects related to quality, safety, patient experience, regulatory performance, health equity, and internal system goals.
Leads enterprise-level analytic initiatives spanning multiple hospitals, departments, and business functions, coordinating complex workstreams and balancing competing organizational priorities.
Serves as a primary analytics consultant for assigned business units, departments, committees, or enterprise-wide quality initiatives by defining analytic requirements, interpreting findings, and recommending data-driven actions.
Works collaboratively with operational, clinical, administrative and executive leaders to translate business needs and strategic objectives into analytic solutions, performance measures, and actionable insights that support operational and financial decision-making, quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and enhanced patient outcomes.
Provides subject matter expertise for quality measurement methodologies, regulatory reporting programs, public reporting, value-based purchasing, and performance improvement initiatives.
Provides consultative expertise to senior leaders on performance improvement opportunities, regulatory strategy, public reporting implications, and organizational benchmarking.


Data Reporting, Visualization & Dashboard Development


Designs, develops, maintains, and enhances reporting and analysis tools, including dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, recurring reports, and ad hoc analyses.
Creates reports and dashboards that track multidimensional performance against system, regional, hospital, department, service line, regulatory, and quality improvement goals.
Draws upon advanced technical skills, including programming and/or query skills, business intelligence and data visualization tools to display key results, including trends, variation, control charts, failure rates, stratified analyses, and other displays that support clear communication through data.
Prepares comprehensive reports, dashboards, summaries, and presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develops predictive models, scenario analyses, and forecasting tools to estimate organizational performance under value-based purchasing, regulatory, contractual, reimbursement, and public reporting programs.
Transforms complex analytic findings into executive-level insights that identify emerging risks, incentive opportunities, and reputational indicators to support strategic planning.


Data Analysis, Mapping & Insight Generation


Leverages software applications to design solutions, perform complex data mapping and analysis, and generate business, clinical, regulatory, and quality intelligence.
Extracts, integrates, and analyzes data from multiple internal and external sources. Audits data, investigates discrepancies, resolves issues, and collaborates with appropriate teams to address data quality concerns.
Interprets complex data, validates analytic findings, and ensures analyses are accurate, complete, and actionable to support organizational decision-making.
Performs advanced statistical, comparative, and trend analyses to identify performance drivers, evaluate interventions, quantify organizational risk, and support evidence-based decision-making.
Synthesizes complex analytic findings into strategic recommendations that influence organizational priorities, regulatory compliance, financial incentives, and quality improvement efforts.


Data Integrity, Metric Stewardship & Documentation


Ensures the integrity, quality and standardization of data meets operational requirements, reporting standards, regulatory specifications and organizational goals.
Translates business needs and reporting requirements into technical specifications, metric definitions, analytic methods, and report production processes.
Develops and maintains documentation of analytic methods, metric development, dashboard logic, data dictionaries, and report production processes.
Acts as a system resource and integral member of data integrity and governance, analytics, and reporting efforts.
Serves as an enterprise resource for data governance, analytic methodologies, reporting standards, and performance measurement to ensure consistency across the health system.
Identifies opportunities and leads initiatives to automate reporting processes, improve analytic efficiency, and enhance data governance practices through emerging technologies and advanced analytics.


Collaboration, Dissemination & User Support


Collaborates with Information Systems, Data Governance, Quality, Patient Safety, Regulatory, Patient Experience, Performance Improvement, clinical leaders, and operational teams to develop, maintain, and optimize reporting applications, analytics solutions and data sources.
Oversees routine and ad hoc dissemination of key information to stakeholders, including weekly, monthly, quarterly, executive, governance, regulatory, and operational reporting as assigned.
Evaluates the utility of reporting methods and visual representations to improve communication, usability, and decision-making through data.
Provides analytic expertise and guidance to stakeholders and may serve as a team leader for projects or work groups, fostering collaboration, improving workflows, and supporting successful project execution.
Mentors analysts and serves as a technical resource for advanced analytic methodologies, reporting standards, data visualization best practices, and quality measurement.
Supports organizational education related to quality initiatives, regulatory programs, performance metrics, and analytic reporting by developing training materials, metric definitions, documentation, user guides, and educational resources for stakeholders.
Partners with clinical, operational, and technical teams to evaluate, implement, and optimize artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM), and automation solutions that improve data abstraction, registry reporting, regulatory workflows, and analytic efficiency.
Serves as a quality and safety subject matter expert to support development, validation, and governance of AI-enabled analytic tools and prompt frameworks to ensure accurate, reliable, and responsible use in analytics for actionable improvement efforts.


Strategic Performance Analytics


Leads analytic support for enterprise regulatory reporting and value-based performance programs, including CMS, Joint Commission, Leapfrog, NHSN, HEDIS, AHRQ, patient experience, and other federal, state, commercial, and accreditation reporting requirements.
Coordinates enterprise reporting calendars, regulatory submission timelines, validation/audit activities, and reporting dependencies to ensure timely and accurate submission of required deliverables.
Develops predictive analytics, scenario modeling, and performance forecasting that incorporate anticipated changes to regulatory and performance measurement programs to estimate organizational performance, reimbursement, incentive payments, penalties, and publicly reported ratings.
Monitors regulatory updates and evolving measurement specifications, assesses organizational impact, and recommends reporting, analytic, and operational strategies to support organizational readiness.
Synthesizes organizational performance trends, external benchmarks, and quality intelligence into strategic recommendations that support executive decision-making, organizational priorities, and long-term planning.


Minimum Qualifications

Education


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Mathematics, Allied Health, Public Health, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Master's degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, or equivalent preferred.


Licensure, Certification & Registration


CPHQ, Lean Six Sigma, Epic, Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, SQL, data analytics, healthcare quality, or related certification preferred.


Experience


Five to eight years of related work experience required.
Strong experience in data management, report writing, analytics, visualization, dashboard creation, and interpretation of large data sets required.
Experience using multiple data sources, hospital systems, relational databases, business intelligence tools, or reporting applications required.
Experience with quality, safety, regulatory, patient experience, population health, or performance improvement data preferred.
Experience with predictive modeling, machine learning technologies, or advanced analytic methods preferred.


Skills, Knowledge & Abilities


Advanced proficiency with data analysis, reporting, and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Epic SlicerDicer, SAS, R, Python, or similar tools.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.
Ability to translate business needs and stakeholder questions into technical specifications, analytic plans, dashboards, reports, and actionable insights.
Strong understanding of healthcare quality, safety, patient experience, regulatory, and performance measurement programs.
Ability to validate data, troubleshoot discrepancies, and ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting.
Ability to analyze complex data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate findings clearly to technical, clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Strong data storytelling skills, including the ability to display key results through effective visualizations and concise interpretation.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and complete analytic work in a timely and efficient manner.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to build effective working relationships across departments and disciplines.
Commitment to health equity, transparency, continuous improvement, and using data to support organizational learning and better outcomes.


Preferred Qualifications & Skills


Working knowledge of programming or query languages such as SQL, Python, R, or similar tools preferred.
Experience with business intelligence tools for data visualization, dashboard development, and report automation, such as Power BI, Tableau, Epic reporting tools, or similar platforms preferred.
Understanding of data management, data manipulation, and interpretation of large databases in a healthcare or medical center environment preferred.


Pay Range

$75,000.00 USD - $125,000.00 USD

Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Payer
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst on the Veeva Compass Product Team, you will play a key role in supporting the core data structures and processes that drive the development of Payer data. You will contribute to data collection, normalization, and analysis to help build Payer reference data. You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and governance for the payer data domain, a foundational reference data set. As a part of our Compass Product Team, you will work alongside Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Terminologists, and Data Analysts to deliver high quality Payer data within our Compass suite of products.

This role is well-suited for someone with a deep understanding of the US insurance landscape, who is also passionate about solving complex data problems. You have a high attention to detail, and a focus on delivering high quality work. In this role, you will be the bridge between the nuances of payer data and actionable product insights.

What You’ll Do


Collect and Maintain Source Data: Identify new data sources and opportunities for automation to ensure all information remains accurate and current
Analyze Data Quality: Execute ongoing quality improvement plan to refine matching process and reduce unmapped data
Establish Governance Standards: Define and maintain standards, documentation, and stewardship models for the payer data domain
Stay Current on the Payer Landscape: Track market trends, including mergers, acquisitions, and rebranding, to assess their impact on our data products
Collaborate on Platform Improvements: Partner with product managers, engineers, and analysts to build scalable, automated processes that ensure trusted data delivery


Requirements


4+ years working with healthcare data, with 2+ years focused on payer data (e.g., payers on claims, payment systems, formulary data)
Deep understanding of the US insurance market, including the nuanced relationships between PBMs and payers across different types of insurance coverage (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Assistance Programs)
Proficient in SQL for querying, analyzing, and validating large data sets
Proven ability to identify new data sources, establish extraction best practices, and merge them into existing sets
Demonstrated experience in data governance, including theability to create and enforce data standards and naming conventions across a pipeline
Collaborative mindset, with the ability to define data requirements across cross-functional teams


Nice to Have


Experience integrating payer data with other healthcare data types, such as HCO or claims data, is a significant advantage
Experience with Market Access Analytics
Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Job Description

Are you inspired to join an organization with a strong culture that’s focused on ensuring we hear all voices, being brilliant on the basics, and developing our teams and leaders? Title: Advanced Analytics & Revenue Strategy Reporting Analyst
Description:
Ocean Spray is hiring for a(n) Advanced Analytics & Revenue Strategy Reporting Analyst! We’re a team of farmers, thinkers, creators, and doers. Whatever your title, whatever your role — it always comes back to this: we’re a farmer-owned co-op where everyone rolls up their sleeves to get the job done. Three maverick farmers started it all — and we’ve been making our own way ever since.

The Advanced Analytics & Revenue Strategy Reporting Analyst impacts the future success of Ocean Spray by developing and maintaining reports that address business questions and deliver insights that lead to greater sales and profit. The role requires the ability to work cross functionally with multiple business partners and stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines. The ability to translate multiple complex data sets into clear and concise reporting and dashboards is essential to the role.

They will also assist with the development, integration, and commercialization of learnings across Ocean Spray and functional partners to analyze data, standardize KPIs, develop internal score cards, all while driving best practices.

A Day in the Life...


Update sales, media, innovation, and buyer behavior reporting.
Assist with Sales & Trade spend reporting, data queries, pulls and analyses.
Support the optimization of existing reports inclusive of both front end and back-end improvements as well as support the transition to centralized reporting workspaces.
Help facilitate data driven decision making by providing insights and trends pertinent to the business.
Work to understand key business questions and assist in developing report tracking, KPIs and dashboards to help best manage the business.
The ability to analyze large, complex internal data sources, providing analytic solutions, cross-group guidance, and support training where necessary for interpretation and implementation of results.
Ability to perform ad hoc analyses to answer business questions and support decision-making


Required

What We Are Looking For:


Bachelor’s Degree
1+ years of relevant experience
Understanding of syndicated (e.g. Nielsen, IRI, SPINS) and POS data
Understanding of PowerBI (or other reporting platform) including establishment of data models, applications, reporting, and executive dashboards

Understanding of key financial metrics and their drivers
Strong written and oral communication


Education

Bachelor's or University Degree (Required)

Work Experience

At least 1 Year of Experience

Annual Salary

$65,700 - $82,100

Certain positions may be eligible for short-term and long-term incentive rewards. We also offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being.

Benefits


Complete insurance package on Day-1 that includes a plethora of health and wellness programs
Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Life and accident insurance
Employee assistance program
Telehealth services
1:1 health coaching
Supportive benefits for all the stages of your life

Short-Term Incentive/Performance bonuses
Flexible scheduling options
Vacation pay, up to three weeks of time (pro-rated for your first year of employment)
Holiday pay for 12 holidays
Career development and growth opportunities
Tuition/Education assistance programs
Access to LinkedIn Learning

Bright Horizons Family Solutions – Back-up care, tutoring, etc.
Adoption assistance
Bereavement leave

Up to $300 massage reimbursement
Employee appreciation events
Employee discounts
Charitable giving

You might have our iconic cranberry juice in your fridge or have gotten into heated holiday debate about what’s better - canned or fresh cranberry sauce. Title: Analyst II, GTM Analytics & BI
Description:
Meet Our Team


PLEASE NOTE: We are currently considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Waltham office and those who wouldn't require sponsorship now or in the future.***


Our team stands at the forefront of data analytics, leveraging cutting-edge technology including generative AI to create sophisticated data products. We are passionate about driving data driven decisions and scaling our business that leads to positive business outcomes. We’ve built relationships as trusted business partners to our stakeholders and are constantly looking for ways to improve how we work and look at our business. The team is highly collaborative within Pega and a team first approach. We work with a high sense of excellence and urgency to deliver the best possible work product to drive results. The team values collaboration, learning, and mentorship, and provides a strong environment for analysts to grow their skills and impact.

Picture Yourself At Pega

You will be part of a highly innovative company, changing how companies work and optimizing their outcomes. In this role you will be part of a collaborative team that is well versed and skilled in their space. You will be an adaptive/flexible change agent driving data driven decisioning while seeing the benefits of your hard work turn into business outcomes. You'll work alongside high-performing team members who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with data analytics and AI.

What You'll Do At Pega

The Go-to-Market Analytics and Insights Analyst II will partner with other internal team members, as well as partners across the Go-to-Market function. This role will be a key business partner to these teams by building and maintaining data products to support actionable insights that help drive optimal business outcomes. You will contribute to ongoing analytics initiatives, help ensure data quality and consistency, and look for opportunities to improve how data is delivered and used across the business.

In This Role You Will


Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical data products used by GTM teams
Ensure data products deliver accurate, consistent, and actionable insights aligned to standardized KPI definitions and data models
Apply best practices in data visualization, performance optimization, and reporting design to improve usability and adoption
Contribute to the development and enhancement of data products that improve efficiency and support decision-making
Partner with stakeholders and team members to translate business needs into reporting and analytical outputs
Perform ad hoc analyses to uncover insights and support business performance
Contribute to the design and evolution of scalable analytical solutions and reporting approaches
Define requirements, logic, and structure for dashboards and analyses with guidance and feedback from team members
Help standardize reporting structures, KPI frameworks, and data product design
Identify opportunities to improve analytical approaches, reporting processes, and data quality
Collaborate on team initiatives exploring new tools, technologies, and analytical approaches (e.g., GenAI-enabled analytics, automation)
Support continuous improvement through documentation, process enhancements, and adoption of best practices


Who You Are

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in reporting and analytics and contributes accurate, consistent outputs. You’re intellectually curious about data and how it drives business decisions, motivated to solve problems, and excited to continue developing your technical, analytical, and communication skills in a fast paced, collaborative environment. You take ownership of your work, actively seek learning opportunities through hands on experience, feedback, and mentorship, and contribute thoughtfully to team initiatives. You enjoy working with modern analytics tools and are energized by the opportunity to support meaningful business outcomes while steadily expanding your impact over time.


Solid foundation in reporting, data analysis, and visualization, with experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports
Detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy, consistency, and alignment to defined metrics and business logic
Analytical thinker who connects data outputs to business context and supports actionable insights
Independently manages reporting and data-related tasks with guidance as needed
Organized and able to manage multiple priorities effectively
Identifies issues, asks clarifying questions, and progresses work to completion
Collaborates effectively with team members and stakeholders to deliver consistent outputs
Experience working with data tools across reporting, data management, and visualization
Continues to build skills in data modeling and scalable reporting approaches
Works in evolving problem spaces using structured, data-driven approaches


What You've Accomplished


Brought new innovative ideas and approaches to looking at data and reports that led to groundbreaking new insights.
Taken complex data/information and make it simple, scalable, and actionable that led to measurable business impact.
Established strong stakeholder relationships and provided support to ensure success.
Have turned data into trusted information used to drive decisions and actions.
Identified process gaps or areas for optimization while also helping drive it from design to completion.


Pega Offers You


Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
Continuous learning and development opportunities
An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
Experience rapid professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex business challenges
Opportunities to take ownership of significant projects that directly impact business outcomes
Contribute to shaping the future of our analytics capabilities
Remote work options
Flexible PTO policy
Culture that celebrates innovation and continuous learning


Additional Information

Base salary range for this role is 71,300 - 106,600 USD annually. This role may also be eligible for annual bonus OR commission, as well as benefits and other incentives.

The final compensation will be determined during the offer process based on the candidate's education, experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as market conditions and may vary from the posted range. We will share an information on benefits, bonus/commission, and other pay components for this role at the relevant recruitment stage.

Title: Customer Insights Analyst
Description:
Reporting to: SVP, Strategic Analytics

Department: Strategic Analytics

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Grand Circle Corporation is the leader in international travel, adventure and discovery for Americans aged 50+. Headquartered in Boston MA, and with more than 35 offices globally, more than two million Americans have traveled with our award-winning travel brands: Grand Circle Cruise Line, Overseas Adventure Travel and Grand Circle Travel.

We’re looking for a Customer Insights Analyst to transform how we understand and predict customer behavior. Embedded within the Strategic Analytics department, you will use data to shape brand development and bring value to customers and business teams. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and business strategy.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze customer behavior patterns to identify actionable insights and opportunities for targeted marketing interventions
Collaborate with data engineering and BI to ensure data quality and reporting accessibility
Define and monitor KPIs that align with business objectives
Build conceptual dashboards that track customer journeys and identify optimization opportunities
Partner with brand, marketing, and other business teams to translate analytical findings into measurable business impact
Tell data-driven stories that convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations
Develop predictive models for key business metrics including churn, lifetime value, and propensity scoring
Design and run experiments to test hypotheses about customer engagement and measure impact of strategic initiatives


Qualifications


2+ years in data analysis, preferably in a subscription or loyalty focused B2C environment
Advanced SQL proficiency (complex queries, window functions, and optimization)
Strong statistical foundation with hands-on experience in regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis
Proficiency in Python or R for analysis and modeling
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or similar)
Proven ability to communicate the results and recommendations of your analysis to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or quantitative field


Technical Skills


Experience working with cloud data warehouses and large-scale datasets
Proficiency with version control and collaborative development practices
Understanding of data pipeline concepts and ETL processes
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and services
Knowledge of data governance and security best practices


Nice to Have


Experience with customer data platforms or marketing automation
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow)
A/B testing and experimental design expertise
Familiarity with causal inference methodologies and experimentation techniques
Prior experience in travel or hospitality industry


Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $130,000 annually for employees based in Boston, MA. Final compensation may vary and will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and first-class benefits, which include:


Health & wellness: Comprehensive and heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, plus on-site gym access, holistic wellness sessions, and group fitness classes
Time for you: Substantial Paid Time Off (PTO), and 11 paid holidays- including Juneteenth, Memorial Day, and Labor Day – and Summer Fridays. Plus- extensive parental leave, with up to 12-16 weeks paid leave at 100% base salary.

JOB TITLE: Finance Data & Transformation Analyst

REPORTING TO: Finance Manager, IH&S

LOCATION: Remote

Who is IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)?

As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, IH&S has a long history of driving growth in life sciences and healthcare by embracing innovation and redefining the supplier-customer relationship. The work we do every day allows us to discover key insights and break new ground to create some of the most meaningful technologies that have a lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. One of business segments is called Life Science Fluidics and we are looking to add more talent to the team.

IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)

IH&S is comprised of six domestic and one international business unit. IH&S is a manufacturing and R&D focused team that sits at the leading edge of high-end fluidic and optical applications for life sciences. Focused on assisting partners at every stage of the development processes, we invest in people and infrastructure to drive bold ideas and pragmatic solutions. With the rich foundation of talent, universities, and supporting businesses, IH&S is the ideal location to elevate your career with fascinating work and endless opportunities.

Our formula for success is simple. We work hard to maintain a culture where you can own your work; you are encouraged to try new ideas in a collaborative environment; and you can apply your skillset to enable our clients to gain a competitive advantage in their own market. At IDEX Health & Science, you will have the opportunity to work with a great group of people, mentor others, and build a great future.

Scope Of Role

This position plays a critical role in advancing IH&S’s finance data transformation initiatives by focusing on developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, enabling standardized financial reporting, and translating complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-ready insights. In addition to supporting ongoing reporting needs, this individual will contribute to the design and implementation of scalable data models that support forecasting, KPI tracking, and executive-level performance visibility. Working within an Agile framework, this role will prioritize enhancements and ensure delivery of high-impact analytics solutions that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

Essential Duties


Building data models and creating processes for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting cycles, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of data
Analyze financial and operational data to identify ways to capture and report on trends, variances, risks, and opportunities, and present findings to finance leadership
Partner with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, IT, and Operations teams to ensure data consistency, and alignment between the tools (dashboards/reports) used for financial reporting and to monitor business performance drivers
Maintain and prioritize reporting and analytics backlogs leveraging the Agile framework.
Support executive-level reporting by creating clear, concise, and visually compelling dashboards and summaries.
Contribute to finance and business transformation initiatives, including automation of reporting processes and improvement of data accessibility and usability
Support various workflows by developing financial KPI calculation logic, creating PBI visuals for leadership consumption.
Support standardized reporting frameworks and ongoing transformation initiatives related to forecasting, reporting standardization, and data governance


Job Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field, with an emphasis in quantitative methods, statistical modeling, and data science.
3+ years of experience in financial analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics roles in a manufacturing financial environment.
Strong understanding of and experience with financial accounting concepts including financial reporting, cost accounting, FP&A. and KPI development
Understanding of ERP software is required, proficiency in JD Edwards is preferred.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is preferred. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum outside of traditional software design is ideal.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX and data modeling.
Attention to detail, with consistent application of audit trails, versioning, and documented best practices.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization.

While the full compensation range for this role is listed below, our anticipated hiring range is $90,000-$105,000 . This projected range is an estimate and will vary based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications, so it is not a guaranteed offer amount. This position may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus plan.

This position is a remote role; however, we are seeking candidates who reside within reasonable proximity to an IDEX Health & Science (IH&S) location. While day‑to‑day work is performed remotely, occasional on‑site collaboration, training, or team events may be required. Applicants should be located close enough to commute to an IH&S facility when needed.

Lead business requirement gathering
Identify data source(s) and develop technical data design requirements
Develop viz wireframes and leverage BI tools to craft visualizations and dashboards
Write SQL queries to develop data sources
Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders for QA and UAT
Conduct stakeholder training
Share knowledge within COBA and train analysts on common tasks
Contribute to development of analytic assets that can be used institute wide
Address stakeholder feedback, concerns and aim to deliver a high-level of customer service

Proficient with SQL
Proficient with BI tools e.g., Tableau
Proficient navigating Epic Hyperspace to Clarity Data Model to data warehouse
Able to set appropriate expectations, discuss and present results to customer in formal settings, share ideas accurately and communicate them effectively, both in writing and verbally with supervisory oversight
Ability to contribute to the development and growth of others
Strong interpersonal skills with ability to effectively interact with all levels of staff
Excellent analytical, organizational, and time management skills
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
Curious and motivated learner


Minimum Job Qualifications

The position requires a bachelor’s degree in a STEM field and at least 3 years of relevant experience, including 1 year in healthcare. Experience with Tableau and Clarity Data models is preferred.

Title: Clinical Data Analyst
Description:
The Clinical Data Analyst (CDA) is a mid-level individual contributor role that supports the Data Sciences department in identifying requirements and building solutions towards enhancing clinical study data reporting and analytics capabilities.  This role will support in the development of advanced analytical solutions, better supporting internal and external stakeholders needs in summarizing clinical study data. This role will also enable operational quality and efficiency through the generation and analysis of departmental operational and performance metrics.




 




Reporting Standards Management


Lead the creation & development of a standard library of reporting and/or analysis solutions (report, dashboard, visualization, or other) for Data Sciences and other stakeholders


Gather requirements from a cross-functional group to a particular study question or operational activity


Build & configure solution to meet the requirements


Lead validation activities to prepare reporting solutions for release/usage


Gather (as needed) and collaborate with volunteer stakeholder group to support validation activities


Contribute to the Data Standards Governance Committee (DSGC) for the management of standard reports


Maintain ongoing updates to standard report templates


Support training for the Data Sciences team of new standard reports/solutions







Study-Specific Reporting Deployment


Deploy standard reporting solutions for use on a study-specific basis


Create & develop ad hoc reporting and/or analysis solutions – report, dashboard, visualization, or other – as requested by study team members


Gather requirements from study team member(s) for ad hoc solutions


Build & configure ad hoc solutions to meet the requirements


Support report requestor in validation activities of study-specific ad hoc solutions to prepare for release/usage


Support long-term maintenance of study-specific solutions and contribute to investigating issues, as raised by study team members







Department Operational & Performance Analysis


Identify requirements with Data Sciences leaders to measure & monitor operational and performance metrics


Design, build, and maintain metrics governance within Data Sciences


Work with large data sets to analyze operational & study data and deliver reporting that outline areas for process & performance improvement/optimization (inefficiencies, inaccuracies, and other issues) to Data Sciences leadership







Technical Systems


Participate in the strategy, management and integration of data reporting systems that impact Data Sciences, including the assessment, integration, build of vendor systems and Alimentiv technologies


Act as a technical system subject matter expert; perform validation and testing of systems


Help gather and determine requirements for relevant technical systems, with cross-functional groups or other Business/Process analysts. Work closely with other technical roles (Data Management, Database Programming, Statistics, Enterprise Analyses, etc.) to drive data governance and excellence


Assess ways to further leverage existing systems to optimize internal efficiencies and processes


Support Data Sciences contribution to a Data Warehouse, contributing to key decisions and strategy


While evaluating new projects or requests for enhancements, help determine the project cost, timeline, goals and feasibility and then support the project through completion







Qualifications


Minimum of a Bachelor's degree + 4-6 years of related experience


Strong analytical skills


Visual design and aesthetic sense to produce appealing and intuitive outputs


Proficiency with data visualization tools (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc)


Skilled data storyteller to communicate complex information in clear and effective manner


Strong collaborator


Preference to certificate in data analysis, data visualizations, or technical solutions (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.)


Preference to prior Clinical Research and/or Clinical Data Management experience







Working Condition


Home-based

Title: Technical Data Analyst 5423

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive Technical Data Analyst to support enterprise data quality, migration, and integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have experience with data migration planning and execution, including assessing, profiling, cleansing, validating, and transforming large datasets, while also developing reporting and integration solutions to support multiple business and technical teams.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data management within enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality principles, and data lifecycle management.
Demonstrated strength in verbal and written communication tailored for technical, cross-functional, and executive audiences.




Technical Skills

Experience performing data profiling to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and validity of enterprise data.
Proven ability to execute data cleansing, standardization, deduplication, and validation activities using established data quality methodologies.
Experience developing and maintaining data mapping documents, data conversion templates, validation templates, reconciliation reports, and data quality scorecards.
Proficiency in writing SQL and scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to automate data cleansing, transformation, validation, and reconciliation processes.
Experience in creating automated validation routines to compare source and target datasets and identify data quality issues.
Strong knowledge of relational databases and data modeling concepts.
Reporting & Analytics
Experience developing interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Microsoft Power BI.
Ability to analyze data quality metrics and communicate findings through executive dashboards and technical reports.
Experience creating KPIs and visualizations to monitor data quality, migration progress, and operational performance.

Experience working with MuleSoft for API-led integrations and enterprise data exchange.
Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, XML, and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience supporting API testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with integrating cloud applications, including CRM platforms such as Salesforce, using APIs.

Preferred Qualifications

Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable identifying gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities in data migration, reporting, and integration workstreams.
Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining data migration plans for enterprise data migration initiatives
Experience supporting Salesforce CRM implementations, migrations, or data quality initiatives.
Experience with ETL/data integration tools and enterprise data migration projects.
Familiarity with data quality platforms such as Cloudingo, DemandTools, Informatica, Talend, or similar solutions.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments and using tools to support implementations such as Jira.
Knowledge of healthcare, provider, payer, or regulated industry data.

Perform data profiling and quality assessments to identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplicates, and validation issues.
Design and execute data cleansing and transformation activities to improve data quality.
