Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About the Role: Data Analyst

We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to turn raw data into actionable insights, build interactive dashboards, and support data-driven decision-making across cross-functional teams. In this role, you will analyze complex datasets, maintain data pipelines, and partner with stakeholders to solve business problems and optimize performance.

Core Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights: Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and operational performance metrics.
Dashboard & Reporting: Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and automated reports using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, business, and engineering teams to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and deliver actionable recommendations.
Data Modeling & Querying: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from databases and data warehouses, maintaining data accuracy and integrity.
Process Automation: Streamline data collection and reporting workflows using scripting languages like Python or R.
Documentation & Quality: Document data definitions, analytical processes, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency and quality control.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field (Required).
Experience: 0–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting.
Technical Skills (Required):
Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying and extraction.
Hands-on experience with data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts.
Scripting ability in Python or R for data analysis and manipulation (Pandas, NumPy).
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (PivotTables, Advanced Formulas, Power Query).
Preferred Skills:
Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Familiarity with cloud analytics environments (AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake).
Knowledge of statistical methods and basic predictive modeling techniques.

What We Offer

Targeted Placement: Direct marketing to our network of hiring managers in the Data, Technology, and Business Analytics sectors.
Technical Resume Rebuild: Optimization of your profile to highlight data analytics tools, SQL proficiency, and business impact.
Interview Coaching: Guidance on behavioral questions, SQL technical assessments, and data case studies.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how the company measures success, identifies growth opportunities, and makes data-informed decisions. You will develop scalable data models, establish analytical frameworks, and translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product strategy and business outcomes. You will own analyses that evaluate product performance and customer behaviour, using cohort/retention analysis and funnel analytics to uncover what drives sustainable growth. You thrive as a generalist, moving seamlessly between evaluating the potential of new categories and diagnosing changes across established ones.

You Will:


Serve as a technical expert and end-to-end owner of product data sources, analytics infrastructure, data models, and measurement frameworks
Define and monitor KPIs that determine the health of a category (adoption, retention, conversion, unit economics, cross-sell, etc.)
Partner with Product to evaluate feature adoption, identify opportunities, and influence roadmap prioritization through data
Design measurement frameworks to evaluate product launches, experiments, and strategic initiatives
Identify drivers of customer retention through cohort analysis and recommend opportunities to improve long-term engagement
Improve analytical processes and automate recurring workflows that enable faster, more reliable product decision-making
Lead the development and maintenance of dbt data models and orchestrations, ensuring accuracy, modularity, and performance optimization
Build trusted, self-serve reporting and semantic data models that enable teams to answer questions independently
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses with clear recommendations and present those findings to senior stakeholders in a way that drives decisions


You Have:


5+ years of experience in data roles
Expert SQL skills with experience writing performant, maintainable, and well-tested queries
Experience building and maintaining analytics workflows with dbt
Strong version control skills with Git
Proven experience with retention/cohort analysis and funnel/conversion analysis
Familiarity with statistical experimentation and A/B testing principles
Experience working on new product, market, or category launches is a strong plus
Strong project management and communication skills, with a results-oriented mindset


Benefits


Full medical, dental and vision benefits
Maternity/paternity policy
4 weeks vacation (3 weeks anytime + 1 week during the holidays)
Competitive compensation
Stock option grant
Remote first, work from anywhere in Canada

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how the company measures success, identifies growth opportunities, and makes data-informed decisions. You will develop scalable data models, establish analytical frameworks, and translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product strategy and business outcomes. You will own analyses that evaluate product performance and customer behaviour, using cohort/retention analysis and funnel analytics to uncover what drives sustainable growth. You thrive as a generalist, moving seamlessly between evaluating the potential of new categories and diagnosing changes across established ones.

You Will:

  • Serve as a technical expert and end-to-end owner of product data sources, analytics infrastructure, data models, and measurement frameworks
  • Define and monitor KPIs that determine the health of a category (adoption, retention, conversion, unit economics, cross-sell, etc.)
  • Partner with Product to evaluate feature adoption, identify opportunities, and influence roadmap prioritization through data
  • Design measurement frameworks to evaluate product launches, experiments, and strategic initiatives
  • Identify drivers of customer retention through cohort analysis and recommend opportunities to improve long-term engagement
  • Improve analytical processes and automate recurring workflows that enable faster, more reliable product decision-making
  • Lead the development and maintenance of dbt data models and orchestrations, ensuring accuracy, modularity, and performance optimization
  • Build trusted, self-serve reporting and semantic data models that enable teams to answer questions independently
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses with clear recommendations and present those findings to senior stakeholders in a way that drives decisions

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data roles
  • Expert SQL skills with experience writing performant, maintainable, and well-tested queries
  • Experience building and maintaining analytics workflows with dbt
  • Strong version control skills with Git
  • Proven experience with retention/cohort analysis and funnel/conversion analysis
  • Familiarity with statistical experimentation and A/B testing principles
  • Experience working on new product, market, or category launches is a strong plus
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with a results-oriented mindset

Benefits

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Maternity/paternity policy
  • 4 weeks vacation (3 weeks anytime + 1 week during the holidays)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Stock option grant
  • Remote first, work from anywhere in Canada
  • Professional development opportunities, working closely with founders and the senior leadership team
